abstract: This paper presents a technique for Hindi Named Entity Recognition (NER) using transformer encoders and a gazetteer-based approach. NER is a crucial task in natural language processing that involves identifying entities and their types in text sequences. However, real-world NER tasks are challenging due to short contexts and complex and emerging entities. To address these challenges, this technique uses a gazetteer-adapted integration network that combines the advantages of existing knowledge (gazetteer) with transformer-based encoders for predicting NER tags. However, integrating a gazetteer into the learning process can lead to weaker learning outcomes because the gazetteer contains specific entity information that can bias the learning process. To overcome this, the technique integrates the gazetteer and language model in a two-step process to minimize data loss and increase model efficiency. The technique uses MuRIL and XLM-R transformer-based language models for feature extraction. Additionally, the technique uses the SPARQL query language to extract entities from Wikidata to construct a Hindi language gazetteer for targeted entity types. The technique utilizes a Contextual Gazetteer Representation (GCR) encoder, which works in conjunction with a word-level model and a Mixture-of-Experts gating network. This method selectively combines context and gazetteer features based on certain conditions to address the issue of overuse of features. The experimental results show an improvement in performance, even with a lower coverage rate.

articleTitle: Autonomous Detection of Landing pad in Challenging Terrains for Precise Areal Supply
abstract: Emerging autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV) technology is deeply associated with the detection and classification of objects in its Field of View (FOV). Object localization in an image plays an imperative role in UAVs. Detection and localization of objects are crucial in the domain of UAVs, which are essential for military operations. Military bases in hilly or remote places struggle with adequate daily supplies. Communication with the main camp can be challenging due to weak signal strength in certain areas. A fast and accurate delivery to these areas is essential. This study introduces an innovative method to autonomously deliver the supply to the military camps with an onboard camera on a UAV equipped with the You Only Look Once (YOLO) algorithm to detect and accurately calculate the actual location of military camps. The proposed system is trained to identify the landing pads in various challenging environments like blurry areas and stands as a promising advancement in addressing these critical challenges.

articleTitle: SAMS: Smart Agricultural Monitoring System Integrating Edge AI and IoT for Early Detection of Rice Crop Stress
abstract: This paper presents a Smart Agricultural Monitoring System that integrates Edge AI and IoT technologies for early detection of rice crop stress. The proposed system aims to improve agricultural productivity by providing timely insights into crop health. By leveraging Edge AI, the system can analyze data locally on edge devices, reducing latency and bandwidth requirements. IoT devices are deployed in the field to collect data on various parameters such as soil moisture, temperature, and humidity. The collected data is processed using machine learning algorithms to detect signs of crop stress, enabling farmers to take proactive measures to mitigate potential losses. The effectiveness of the system is demonstrated through experimental results and case studies.

articleTitle: TrustCaller- Voice-based Fraud Prevention System
abstract: An innovative project called “TrustCaller” aims to improve call security. With the goal of establishing caller verification and building trust in incoming calls, the project makes use of state-of-the-art technologies for voice feature extraction, processing, and pattern matching. Utilizing React Native only for the Android application, “TrustCaller” assumes a key function in boosting the security of phone communications when combined with Machine Learning (ML) and Speech Synthesis. This program is a vital step in protecting people from possible dangers and promoting safer phone communication. Moreover, it provides scalable security settings to guarantee users’ privacy and control over communication.

articleTitle: Synergistic Genomic Profiling and Predictive Modeling for Health Outcome Anticipation: A Holistic Strategy Leveraging Gene Expression Analysis
abstract: This paper presents a thorough way to disease prediction that integrates powerful machine learning algorithms with microarray analysis of cancer gene expression. The loading, recording, and cleaning of genetic microarray data is the primary stage in the study’s approach. A collection of genes crucial for illness prediction is discovered when traits are chosen based on statistical significance. The research evaluates how many classifiers, such as Gaussian Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbors, Multi-layer Perceptron, and Extra Trees, are influenced by increasing the number of individual genes. The selecting of essential genes and models is lead by extensive evaluation methodologies and crossvalidation procedures. The research also provides a theoretical framework, underlining the relevance of gene expression patterns in understanding and identifying disorders. The relevance of feature selection and how it influences model performance are underlined in the research. It also looks at the selected strategies and how well they function with genetic data management. The methodology’s success is proved by a comparative analysis of error rates and the choice of the bestperforming software and gene set.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of GNN based approach for Topic Classification of Telugu Text
abstract: Telugu, a Dravidian language spoken by over 80 million people, presents unique difficulties for text processing algorithms. Unlike English, it possesses complex morphology, agglutinative word formation, and rich context-dependent meanings, making it challenging for traditional NLP techniques. This abstract explores these challenges and argues why directly processing Telugu, rather than relying on English translation, is crucial for several reasons such as loss of nuancing and context, semantic ambiguities and idiomatic expressions can be misinterpreted, leading to inaccurate results in tasks like sentiment analysis or question answering. Further, we have utilized various state-of-art techniques to process the text directly in Telugu language rather than converting the text into English. Processing Telugu text directly allows for deeper analysis of its linguistic structure, literary works, and cultural expressions. This fosters a better understanding of Telugu heritage and facilitates its preservation for future generations.

articleTitle: Level Shifted Phase Disposition PWM Control for Quadra Boost Multi Level Inverter
abstract: This article introduces a novel boost switched capacitor Inverter (NBSCI) that significantly advances existing designs. Many recently developed multilevel voltage source inverters stand out for their ability to reduce the number of DC sources while markedly improving voltage levels with fewer switching devices. Building on these advancements, our work proposes an innovative inverter arrangement that, utilizing 1 DC source, eight switches and 3 capacitors, achieves 9-level output voltage waveforms. The increased range of voltage levels facilitates the generation of high-quality sine wave output signals with minimal Total Harmonic Distortion (THD). Also, this work employs Level shifted - Phase Disposition (LS-PD) pulse width modulation techniques to generate gating signals, ensuring the production of superior output waveforms. The article also presents various simulation results conducted using MATLAB-SIMULINK, providing a comprehensive assessment of the proposed configuration’s precise effectiveness under diverse modulation index.

articleTitle: Enhancing DDoS Attack Detection deploying Machine Learning in Software Defined Networking Environment
abstract: The Internet of Things, or IoT, has become essential to contemporary industrial operations due to the widespread use of devices that are connected to the Internet in industrial settings. However industrial networks are now more vulnerable to a range of cybersecurity risks, such as Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, due to their growing connectedness. In this paper, a novel method that combines hybrid machine learning (ML) algorithms with Software Defined Networking (SDN) approaches has been provided to identify DDoS attacks in the IoT space. By utilising the Edge-IIoT dataset, which incorporates information from IoT devices and SDN infrastructure, one may improve the precision and resilience of DDoS detection by combining feature extraction techniques with hybrid ML models. The suggested technique effectively detects DDoS assaults with few false positives, as seen by the experimental findings. This improves the safety stance of industrial networks against the ever-evolving threat landscape. A comparison of the suggested hybrid ML model’s accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score has been made with the different algorithms including KNN [1], RF [2] and LR [3]. The proposed accuracy rises to 99.10%, while the accuracy rates of [1], [2] and [3] are, respectively, 97.15%, 97.99% and 98.39%.

articleTitle: On the Influence of Lightning Channel Inclination to the Current in Various Parts of the Steel Reinforced Building for a Direct Lightning Strike
abstract: This paper explores the impact of lightning channel inclination on the magnitude and characteristics of the current flowing through the base of steel-reinforced concrete columns when a lightning strike occurs on a building. The three various building patterns are examined for the study. The lightning channel length examined for the study is 1 km. The commonly used current source model excites the channel at the base. Electromagnetic model is employed. For the computation Electromagnetic code (NEC-2) is used. The simulations are accomplished for various channel inclinations. The source current is impulse in nature which is a double exponential wave. The impulse wave having various rise times are examined as the source current. The results show that the inclined lightning channel has effect on the magnitude of the current flowing at the base of the columns of the building. However, on the nature of the current there is no much influence by the channel inclination.

articleTitle: Enhancing Radiologist’s Performance in Breast Cancer Screening Using PSO Algorithm with CNN Classifier
abstract: In this Research Paper, we introduce an innovative strategy aimed at improving the performance of radiologists in the crucial task of breast cancer screening. By optimizing parameters for a hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm combined with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), our approach seeks to enhance the accuracy and specificity in the detection and diagnosis of breast cancer. We evaluate the efficacy of our proposed method by comparing it against a conventional approach that utilizes Deep Neural Networks (DNN), focusing on metrics such as accuracy and specificity, as well as the ability to identify both benign and malignant cases. Our findings demonstrate that the PSO-CNN method surpasses the existing DNN-based approach by achieving an accuracy rate of 95.5% compared to 92.8%. This improvement is crucial in the context of breast cancer screening where even minor enhancements in accuracy can significantly impact patient outcomes. Moreover, our method also shows an improvement in specificity reaching a rate of 90% compared to 87.4% in the DNN-based approach, thereby reducing the likelihood of false positives and minimizing unnecessary patient anxiety and follow-up procedures. The effectiveness of our approach is assessed by comparing it with a conventional system that employs Deep Neural Networks (DNN) as the primary diagnostic tool. The comparison focuses on key metrics such as accuracy and specificity, as well as the capability to detect both begin and malignant breast cancer.

articleTitle: Smart Soldier Jacket for Health Monitoring and Secured Data Transmission
abstract: The “Smart Soldier Jacket for Health Monitoring and Secured Data Transmission” is an innovative project designed to enhance military capabilities through cutting-edge technology. The wearable jacket integrates advanced IoT components, including a Raspberry Pi, temperature and heartbeat sensors, biometric authentication, and communication modules such as ZigBee and GSM. It aims to provide real-time monitoring of critical health metrics, ensuring optimal performance in extreme environmental conditions. The inclusion of a biometric sensor and elevated access control adds a layer of security, allowing only authorized personnel access to vital data. The project addresses the evolving challenges faced by modern soldiers, offering a comprehensive solution for health monitoring and secure data transmission. With features like an emergency button and visual displays, the Smart Soldier Jacket exemplifies a fusion of military necessity and technological advancement for improved soldier well-being and operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Classification of Hateful Memes by Multimodal Analysis using CLIP
abstract: Due to the widespread usage of social media platforms, memes and other hateful contents have become a major concern as they propagate harmful stereotypes, and often inciting violence and social tensions in societies. To counter it, this research paper proposes a novel approach for the detection of such hateful memes using multimodal techniques by using the CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) model. As the image and textual parts of the memes are seldom semantically aligned, thus we need to integrate both these information to capture the correct context of the memes to detect the hateful memes. Through extensive testing on a large dataset of memes provided by Meta we demonstrate the accuracy of this approach. Through this paper we contribute to the development and refinement of more robust and ethical solutions to tackle this growing problem of hate speech to promote a healthy and safe discourse on social media.

articleTitle: Economics Load Dispatch Strateiges in Power System
abstract: To appropriately satisfy need while minimizing expenses, modernizing the age and dispersion of power requires the utilization of economic dispatch in power systems. One significant area of productivity in power system game plan is monetary dispatch. This article gives an outline of the monetary dispatch issue, carefully describes it, and takes a gander at expected answers for overcome any barrier between the upwardly organized market and the changed market conditions. Any coordinated power system’s essential objective is to work as economically as conceivable while likewise expanding viability. For some irregular weight interest, the expense old enough of certifiable power at various delivering units can be restricted. Regular surge ought to likewise be thought of, regardless of whether it is costlier. Creating emissions overall are truly obliterating the environment where people reside. Taken together, changed money and release dispatch transform it into a multi-layered improvement issue. This issue is tended to by choosing a notable present day PSO smoothing out, taking 14and 30-transport IEEE test systems, contrasting copied results, and utilizing a genetic algorithm (GA).

articleTitle: Analysis of QLED’s Optical Performance for Variations in Wavelength and Quantum Dot Radius
abstract: This work employs FDTD analysis of QLEDs in relation to conventional OLEDs, with an emphasis on far field light intensity modeling. Our goal is to clarify the mechanisms controlling device performance and offer important insights for the advancement of next-generation QLED technologies by combining theoretical models with practical data. When CdSe is used as the QD material, it is observed that 10nm produces more emission when compared to a normal OLED design. This study investigated how viewing angles affected variations in far-field intensity at a 500 nm operating wavelength. The CdSe-based quantum light-emitting diode (QLED) shifts from 500 nm to 580 nm while keeping the quantum dot (QD) size constant at 10 nm. It is observed that the QLED exhibits a favorable emission rate at 500 nm.

articleTitle: Unlocking Insights: Autoencoder-Enhanced ECG Anomaly Detection using RMSProp
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) is an essential instrument for identifying a variety of cardiac diseases; nevertheless, the manual interpretation of ECG data can be time-consuming and also prone to errors caused by human intervention. In the past several years, approaches that utilize machine learning have demonstrated that they have the potential to automate the identification of ECG irregularities. This research investigates the usage of autoencoders, which are a form of artificial neural network, for the purpose of identifying abnormalities in electrocardiograms (ECGs). In the realm of unsupervised learning algorithms, autoencoders belong to a category of methods that may be utilized for dimensionality reduction and feature learning. An autoencoder is trained to reconstruct normal electrocardiogram signals in the context of electrocardiogram analysis. Abnormalities are identified on the basis of the reconstruction error exceeding a predetermined threshold. The use of this technology has the ability to detect small anomalies in electrocardiogram data that may be overlooked by more conventional approaches.

articleTitle: Patient Risk Classification based on Vital Signs using Machine Learning Algorithm
abstract: Infectious disease is always a serious issue in the world due to the impact of the spread of the disease and mortality. Now a days heart disease is also the most common disease. Heart disease, chronic disease and COVID19 reflected by changes in vital signs. The major vital signs are blood pressure, pulse rate and body temperature. The evolution in Machine Learning plays an important role to improve healthcare facilities and save human lives. The effective diagnosis of heart disease in a shorter time is very important to save human lives. At the same time COVD-19 is also affecting many people worldwide. Machine learning techniques are used for diagnosis of disease. It uses datasets of earlier patient reports. This paper discusses machine algorithms to diagnose and differentiate infectious diseases, chronic disease, and heart disease. As a result, patients facing high risk can be shifted to the ICU and other patients to normal wards. These algorithms are effective in disease screening.

articleTitle: Design of Operational Transconductance Amplifier(OTA) for 1.2V Bandgap Reference(BGR)
abstract: The Operational Transconductance Amplifier (OTA) is an essential and versatile building block of electronic systems. The design of OTA is crucial on achieving low noise, high linearity, and temperature stability, such that it can be used to design a reference voltage for various applications, including analog-to-digital converters. The design parameters, such as transconductance, bandwidth, and power consumption, are tailored to meet the specific requirements for the 1.2V BGR. This work provides 7-pack OTA, which operates with 1.8V power supply gives a gain of 77dB, a phase margin of 72 degrees, -3dB bandwidth of 5.3kHz. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of the OTA design in meeting the specific requirements of the 1.2V BGR. Overall, the engineered OTA using tsmc library 180 nm technology emerges a valuable component for ensuring the stability of the 1.2V reference voltage, which is a critical reference point for a wide range of electronic devices and systems.

articleTitle: Handwritten Text Recognition Using Machine Learning
abstract: Computer vision tasks include image-based sequence recognition for offline handwriting recognition. Conventional methods depend on extensive linguistics knowledge, intricate feature extraction methods, and segmentation. In this paper, a novel method for handwriting identification using Connectionist Temporal Classification in conjunction with Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network is presented. The goal of this work is to categorize a single handwritten word so that handwritten material can be converted to digital format. Since each character’s occurrence is contingent upon the existence of a few preceding characters, the challenge involves both sequence and classification modeling. To create a model that can segment characters and reassemble each word, we look into different neural network topologies. Our model will be trained and tested using the IAM handwriting database. Additionally, the model may be trained globally and across many languages due to the symbolic and character-independent nature of the employed approaches.

articleTitle: Preprocessing of CT Scans for Lung Cancer Detection
abstract: Lung cancer, a pervasive global health concern, requires effective early detection and classification methodologies to improve patient outcomes. This project addresses this challenge by developing a comprehensive framework utilizing medical imaging data for the timely classification of lung cancer with better results of diagnosis. Leveraging advanced processing techniques and DL algorithms, the project aims to make the lung cancer detection system more efficient. By preprocessing DICOM image datasets of lung scans and employing techniques such as noise reduction, contrast enhancement, and feature extraction, the project seeks to improve image quality and extract relevant features.

articleTitle: Feature-based Stationary Wavelet Transform for Removal of EEG Ocular Artifacts
abstract: Ocular artifact is the prominent artifact in EEG signals that significantly affects the operation and interpretation of EEG-based clinical and control applications. This paper proposes an efficient ocular artifact identification and removal algorithm based on feature extraction and stationary wavelet transform (SWT). The EEG channels are decomposed into detail and approximation coefficients based on SWT. Three features, skewness, kurtosis, and peak amplitude of the approximation coefficient, are extracted and thresholded to identify ocular artifacts. The median filtering and inverse SWT are employed to remove the identified artifacts from the contaminated EEG signals. The proposed method is compared with the linear regression and DWT-based denoising techniques and evaluated on a publicly available dataset. To evaluate the effectiveness of the suggested approach, the performance measures “Signal-to-Noise Ratio” (SNR) and “Root Mean Square Error” (RMSE) are adopted. The $\triangle$ SNR values for the proposed algorithm and the other two methods are 26.03 dB, 15.87 dB, and 4.95 dB, respectively. The proposed approach significantly improves the signal quality of the reconstructed EEG signals.

articleTitle: A Framework for Realtime Multiview Yoga Pose Detection and Corrective Feedback Using MoveNet and Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: Human pose detection and correction is a rapidly developing and important field in today’s world. After the advent of COVID-19, people have taken a keen interest in personal health and fitness. Many systems perform pose detection. But, a major issue is that they do not operate in real-time and have high latencies. Our system provides real-time pose detection and feedback, along with low latency. We achieved this by using a human pose estimation (HPE) model called MoveNet, which is ultrafast and more accurate when compared to other HPE models like Mediapipe, OpenPose, etc. In addition to this, our system uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) for multiclass classification to predict the correctness of the pose. Our system takes real-time video input of the user either from the front view or side view. keypoints detected by the MoveNet are given as input to a trained CNN model on a custom dataset which evaluates the correctness. For incorrect poses, real-time text and audio feedback are provided to the user. The CNN model is trained for three yoga poses multiview Tree Pose, Chair Pose, and Cobra Pose. For better correction, a system must support at least two views. Keeping this in mind, we have included multiview support. Our web application system can be used on both mobile and computer.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Chatbot Utility to assist Employees in identifying the Safety Risks based on the Classification of the Industry Incidents
abstract: The advancement in technology has improved the interaction between people and devices in many ways. One such way is a chatbot. Chatbot is an artificial intelligence-based computer program that uses messaging platforms to interact with people. With the evolution of technology, the manpower in industries has been reduced considerably. However, it is still a long way before industries achieve 100% automation. In industries, accidents and injuries are common despite all the safety measures and precautions put in place. It is imperative to classify industrial incidents into distinct categories to ascertain whether the incidence was purely an accident, the result of carelessness or incompetence, or if the causes can be traced back to the industry’s procedures or products. This minimizes the effects, prevents recurrence, and lowers the frequency and intensity of incidents. To achieve this, we employ exploratory data analysis (EDA) on a dataset from major Brazilian industries to determine the most common causes of accidents, types of accidents, timestamps, types of employee injuries, and other factors. This paper aims to develop a chatbot utility that is ML/DL-based and can assist professionals in identifying safety risks.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy based Anaemia diagnosis using LabVIEW
abstract: Anaemia is one of the most common blood diseases in today’s population, which has to be treated at its early stage. Anaemia is a condition where the haemoglobin level present in the blood drops below the normal level or decreases in the red blood cells count. Assisting professionals in the healthcare field with proper technologies plays a vital role in improving the quality of treatment. We propose a novel computational approach using LabVIEW fuzzy logic for the diagnosis of anaemia. Replacing an existing methodology with a prediction model eliminates human intervention so that errors caused by humans are avoided. It predicts not only the presence or absence of anaemia but also a type and severity of anaemia based on the Complete Blood Count test parameters. A 616 unit test has been implemented using Caraya unit test framework, ensuring the proper functioning of the proposed application. Anaemia predictor application provides an interactive GUI to the user and also provides us the facility to maintain a health database.

articleTitle: A Novel Interleaved Quadrature Boost Converter based Analysis of Grid-Tied BLDC Motor in EV Application
abstract: Power demand is increasing globally, necessitating the search for an alternate source to meet the emerging power crisis, which will likely be accomplished through grid-synchronized electric vehicles (EVs). Photovoltaic (PV) power generation has emerged as an appropriate substitute for conventional power generation systems due to its ease of maintenance, sustainability, minimal noise level, and accessibility. The output of the PV panel can be controlled using high-gain and highly effective DC-DC converters. In this paper, an interleaved quadrature Boost converter is utilized to increase the output voltage of a PV system while also providing adequate control for a BLDC motor with a safe and soft start. The Firefly-optimized PI controller methodology outperforms other methods over seamless BLDC motor operation. The PI controller-based PWM generator generates the gating pulses for the interleaved quadrature Boost converter. For speed regulation, the converter result is supplied to the BLDC motor via a three-phase inverter. The use of a Proportional Integral (PI) controller as well as a Firefly-optimized PI controller improves grid synchronization and motor speed regulation. Harmonics are eliminated using an LC filter, and grid synchronization is accomplished using a single-phase inverter. The proposed work is carried out using the MATLAB software, and the results are obtained.

articleTitle: Investigation into Object Classification for Images
abstract: This research delves into the domain of object classification for images, focusing on identifying cherries, strawberries, and tomatoes using deep learning techniques. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) was meticulously designed and trained for this specific task. The dataset comprised 3000 images for training, 600 for validation, and 900 for testing. The primary objective was to evaluate CNN’s performance in accurately categorizing these fruit types. The results of this investigation are noteworthy. The final CNN model yielded an impressive accuracy of $80.77 \%$. In contrast, a Multi-Layer Perception (MLP) model, often used for image classification, achieved a substantially lower accuracy of $37.89 \%$. This substantial performance difference underscores the effectiveness of CNNs in handling image classification tasks, particularly those involving intricate visual distinctions among objects. This paper presents the empirical results and explores key concepts such as Image Classification and Convolutional Neural Networks. Furthermore, it delves into techniques to fine-tune CNN models, highlighting the importance of hyperparameter tuning and architectural choices in achieving superior classification performance.

articleTitle: From Field to Algorithm: A New Strategy for Pusa Gourd Classification Using Advanced CNN and RNN Models in India
abstract: This study examines the classification of several types of Bottle Gourds in India using a novel hybrid model of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). A collection of 8200 images depicting four primary varieties of bottle gourds - Pusa Samridhi, Pusa Naveen, Pusa Meghdoot, and Hybrid 1 from the “Pusa” group - was meticulously assembled and processed before utilization. The strategy for constructing it, by integrating a CNN specialized in image analysis and a RNN proficient in sequential processing, achieved remarkable results with an accuracy rate of 97.4%. Upon rigorous examination, the model demonstrated exceptional proficiency in discerning the minute distinctions that distinguish each variety of plant. Performance metrics like as accuracy in making correct predictions, ability to identify all correct answers even when they were difficult to discern, and a balanced combination of both, indicate that this model excels in achieving high accuracy across all classes. The CNN-RNN model demonstrated superior quality when compared to existing approaches. This implies that it has practical applications and can enhance methods of categorizing bottle gourds. This model’s accuracy surpasses the outdated manual methods of organizing things. This demonstrates the significance of improving agricultural labor and preserving diverse species. This study provides a precise method for categorizing different types of bottle gourds and also lays the foundation for utilizing combined CNN-RNN models in various agricultural scenarios, hence advancing crop sorting and farm technology.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition using Transfer Learning
abstract: For the community of hearing-impaired people, sign language recognition is essential for bridging communication gaps. This paper provides a novel approach that combines transfer learning with the VGG-19 convolutional neural network architecture to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of sign language recognition systems. The suggested method trains the network to recognize the distinct characteristics of sign language motions by utilizing the pretrained VGG-19 model on a sizable image dataset of 300 images for each sign which were fed into the VGG-19 model for training and testing purpose. The model was optimized for precise recognition of various sign language signs by fine-tuning. This reduces the requirement for vast labelled data and training time. This model was successfully implemented by converting the signs to their text equivalents and achieved 99.92% accuracy. Experimental results shows that this strategy is successful and achieves better performance than conventional methods.

articleTitle: Network Function Virtualisation in Software-Defined Networking using Openstack Environment
abstract: The existing networking hardwares present challenges in meeting diverse user demands and adapting to changing network requirements. Traditional networking’s dependency on the networking hardware hampers adaptability. Network Function Virtualisation (NFV) presents a solution by migrating networking functions to software. This paper aims to demonstrate the implementation of Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol(DHCP) as the virtualised network function in Software defined networking (SDN) as the proof of concept. DHCP virtual instances are designed to serve as server which dynamically assigns IP addresses to the DHCP virtual instances that are clients, enabling adaptability to changing network demands. NFV and SDN incredibly present a vital approach by virtualising network functions offering various benefits like dynamic networking, scalability, and efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cyber Logic: A Robust Design of Identity based Encryption Mechanism to Secure Data using Blockchain Technology
abstract: Homomorphic encryption stands as a transformative cryptographic technique, enabling computations on encrypted data sans decryption, a critical feature within privacy-preserving blockchain frameworks. Its integration mitigates the inherent security vulnerabilities of traditional blockchains, safeguarding sensitive data from exposure. Through identity-based encryption (IBE), key generation becomes not only secure but also user-friendly, streamlining access control. Smart contracts automate key distribution, bolstering security while dynamic key generation ensures resilience against potential attacks. Storing encrypted data on the blockchain guarantees confidentiality, with selective data sharing mechanisms offering granular control over information dissemination for collaborative purposes. Privacy-preserving transactions, facilitated by homomorphic operations and zero-knowledge proofs, maintain transactional confidentiality. Effective revocation and key renewal mechanisms further enhance the system’s security posture. Scalability and efficiency are significantly bolstered through the adoption of off-chain computations and batch processing strategies.

articleTitle: Approximate Binary Stacking Counters For Error Tolerant Computing Multipliers
abstract: To increase the power and efficiency of VLSI circuits, a new, creative multiplying methodology is required. Multiplication is a crucial arithmetic operation for many of these applications. As a result, the newly proposed error-tolerant computing multiplier is a crucial component in the design of approximate multipliers that are both power and gate efficient. We have created approximative multipliers for several operand lengths using this suggested method and a 45-nm library. Depending on their probability, the approximation for the accumulation of changing partial products varies. In compared to approximate multipliers that were previously given, the proposed circuit produces better results. When column-wise generate elements are added to the modified partial product matrix using an OR gate, the output is usually accurate. The amount of energy used, and its silicon area have been considerably reduced in the suggested multiplier when compared to traditional multipliers by 41.92% and 18.47%, respectively. One of the platforms that these suggested multipliers are suitable for is the image processing application.

articleTitle: End-to-End Network Traffic Examination for Network Intrusion Detection using Feature Embedding Learning
abstract: The rapid evolution of information sharing and portable device technologies has led to a drastic increase in the number of smart devices, which helps in enhancing the level of comfort and intelligence in every household. It also drives the progress and innovation in different fields, including transportation and healthcare industries. Industrial Control Systems help in the development of society as a whole, by controlling and monitoring the flow of communication between the systems in a industrial network. ICSs have also advanced further due to the presence of smart devices. However, this has also led to a alarming increase in network security concerns. Data security is of the highest priority now. Attacks to the networks present in an ICS also lead to very dangerous outcomes, which may sometimes prove to be fatal. Anomaly detection techniques are mainly used in traditional intrusion detection systems. This is done by detecting any abnormal patterns in the network traffic. To develop an effective and flexible IDS, we are going to examine the Deep Neural Network in this paper. The continuous development of network behaviour and rapid increase in attacks call for development of IDS and evaluating many datasets formed over time using static and dynamic methods. This type of research leads to the identification of the most efficient algorithm for identifying any cyber-attacks in the future. The proposed model achieves higher accuracy than the previous machine learning models.

articleTitle: Optimization-Driven PID Parameter Tuning for Load Frequency Control in a Two-Area Power System
abstract: The paper provides an analysis comparing three optimization algorithms, namely Elephant Herding Optimization (EHO), Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) and Genetic Algorithm (GA). The study endeavors to scrutinize the efficacy and proficiency of these algorithms in addressing optimization dilemmas. The paper begins with an introduction to optimization algorithms, followed by a review on EHO, ABC and GA. The experimental setup and evaluation metrics are then described, the experimental results are showcased and thoroughly examined. The paper concludes by discussing the implications of the findings.

articleTitle: Violence Detection in Automated Surveillance using CNN
abstract: As the world proceeds into the age of automation, the need of manual surveillance becomes increasingly questionable. This is not only due to excessive hours spent behind security monitors, but their continuous ineffectiveness from lapses of lack of concentration among other factors during manual surveillance. Thus, with the aid of Deep Learning and other acclaimed work related to real-time violence detection in surveillance, a conclusive study has led to proposed autonomous system using artificial intelligence. Hence this paper aims to highlight integration of a proposed Convolution Neural Network model that will not only detect violence but informatively alert authorities to the premise of intrusion. We employ what is referred to as a deep lightweight neural network called MobileNetV2. Preferred due to its unique architecture impressively designated for resource-constrained environments and devices, it is ideal for high performance requirement applications with minimal computational capabilities. The model acts as a feature extractor and classifier in training on various datasets. The model achieved the highest accuracy rate of $99 \%$ from one of a datasets.

articleTitle: Clicking Fraud Detection for online advertising using Machine Learning
abstract: Ad agencies have turned their attention to online and in-app advertising in response to the expansion of digital technology and social media. Internet advertising represents a major revenue source for advertising networks that act as intermediaries between advertisers and brands. Ad networks follow a pay-per-click (PPC) payment scheme, based on the number of clicks by advertisers who publish ads but there is a growing security concern with this form of payment known as click fraud. Click fraud is the illegal practice of clicking any paid advertisement to increase publishers’ revenue or damage advertisers’ bottom line. Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to solve complex challenges in various research areas including cybersecurity to achieve unexpected results This paper developed several machine learning models to determine whether the user is human or a bot and a comparative performance analysis using a set of analytical concepts.

articleTitle: Enhancing Green Bean Anthracnose Severity Detection via Integrated CNN-LSTM Models
abstract: Anthracnose, a disease resulting from Colletotrichum fungal species, is one of the most dangerous threats to green pea (Phaseolus vulgaris L.) production worldwide at present. Spotting, recognizing, and taking appropriate actions on anthracnose severity levels would be of great value to putting into practice management strategies for disease control. In this study, an innovative and one-of-a-kind hybrid model of convolutional neural network (CNN)- Longshort-term memory (LSTM) is proposed to detect the severity of anthracnose disease in green bean plants. Images of plants infected and already labeled in the range of 0 (without visible symptoms) to 3 (serious symptoms) were collected in the digital format. preprocessing was done on the dataset that included resizing, normalization, and extra images for better result effectiveness. In parallel, the CNN-LSTM architecture recognized the spatial characteristics of the images with the CNN part and relied on the LSTM to handle the temporal relations between the video sequences. The experimental results showed the ability of the model to precisely detect intensity levels leading to $83 \%$ accuracy and an F1 score of 0.88. Comparison tests against established models further brought out the strong points of a new model. CNN-LSTM model presents a worthy solution in the automatic recognition of specific diseases in farming and may be utilized in the science of precision agriculture and crop management.

articleTitle: Development of QOS Aware Spectrum Access Algorithm for Different Radio Access Techniques (RATS)
abstract: The paper introduces a novel approach to spectrum sensing within cognitive radio systems, proposing the utilization of sub-Nyquist sampling for wideband spectrum sensing to achieve substantial reductions in sample rates without compromising detection accuracy. Employing a subspace estimator, the method discerns occupied and unoccupied channels by analyzing the correlation matrix derived from limited noisy samples. Spectrum sensing, a critical task in cognitive radio, faces challenges due to varying conditions between major user signals and background noise. Leveraging statistical covariances of received signals and noise enables the differentiation between the two. Through comparative analysis utilizing the sample covariance matrix, the paper evaluates spectrum sensing techniques, offering insights into improving detection capabilities amidst dynamic and noisy environments. This research addresses a significant challenge in cognitive radio, providing valuable contributions to the field.

Author Keywords: wide band sensing, narrow band sensing

articleTitle: Analyzing the Effectiveness of Machine Learning Models for Next Day Cryptocurrency Price Prediction
abstract: Crypto currencies represent a digital form of currency, entirely reliant on electronic transactions and lacking a physical counterpart in the form of traditional banknotes. Unlike fiat currencies, they operate in a decentralized manner, free from third-party intervention, enabling users to access services directly. Nevertheless, the volatility in cryptocurrency prices significantly impacts international relations and trade, contributing to economic inequalities on a global scale. This research concentrates on Bitcoin price prediction, a highly popular cryptocurrency widely accepted by various stakeholders, including investors, researchers, traders, and policymakers. Therefore, in this research, it is proposed to compare the performance of two machine learning models (a RNN model and a LSTM model) for bitcoin price prediction. Open and close pricing are the main requirements for implementation of the model. In addition, the research compares the accuracy values of both models for closed prices, contributing to Sustainable Cities and Communities. The results prove that LSTM model is a better choice than RNN model with a very low error of 0.196%.

articleTitle: Development of a Method for the Evaluation of Linear Time-Invariant Systems with Time-Varying Parameters Using Laplace Transform Techniques
abstract: This study proposes an approach that makes use of Laplace transform methods to assess linear time-invariant (LTI) systems with time-varying parameters. The suggested approach provides a methodical way to examine and comprehend how LTI systems behave while their parameter values are fluctuating. The method captures the dynamics of the system and makes it possible to assess how well it performs when different parameter values vary with time. To create a more generalized way of accessing the LTI system with time-varying parameters, modified Laplace transform techniques are suggested. The simulation results show how well the suggested approach works for precisely determining system performance. The design of adaptive filtering techniques and other control strategies can be explored in future studies. Overall, this approach advances system analysis and design by offering a thorough framework for assessing LTI systems with time-varying characteristics.

articleTitle: Load Frequency Control in 2 Area Interconnected Power System Using Ant Colony Optimization
abstract: This study proposes an Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) based Relative Vital Subordinate (PID) controller for Load Frequency Control (LFC) in a 4-region interconnected non-warm nuclear energy system. The system includes governor nonlinearity and dead band effects, which are addressed in the controller design. The ACO calculation is utilized to upgrade the PID controller boundaries, intending to limit the Region Control Mistake (Pro) and work on the system’s frequency and tie-line power stream control. The proposed controller is contrasted and controllers streamlined utilizing different methods, showing predominant execution with regards to settling times and wavering decrease. Awareness and vigor investigation show the viability of the proposed approach under changing system boundaries. Generally speaking, the ACO-PID controller offers a promising answer for improving the stability and efficiency of interconnected power systems.

articleTitle: Machine learning Techniques Based Gas Pipeline Leakage Detection
abstract: The detection of leaks in natural gas pipelines is of paramount importance for ensuring safety, environmental protection, and economic viability of gas transmission systems. Traditional leak detection methods often rely on periodic inspections which may not provide real-time monitoring or sufficient coverage, particularly in remote or inaccessible areas.Recently, there has been a significant uptick in interest regarding the utilization of acoustic signal analysis as a promising method for detecting and pinpointing pipeline leaks. In this paper we discuss a new methodology for diagnosing the gas pipeline leakage based on statical analysis of acoustic data. For this project we are using GPLA12_v3 dataset containing 24 different classification which are classified into 3 groups based on the pressure values. We have also used MFCC features for fault diagnosis which have produced a result of 66% accuracy for Gaussian Navie Bayes classifier. For statical features we got the best accuracy for Random Forest Classifier with an accuracy of 76%

articleTitle: Custom Design of 16 Bit RISC Processor Using Low Power Pipelining
abstract: This work presents a full-custom 16-bit low-power pipelined RISC processor, with a primary focus on achieving low power consumption while enhancing overall performance. The processor employs a four-stage pipelining technique, enabling concurrent execution of multiple instructions. The pipeline stages consist of instruction fetch, decode, execute, and write-back, and it operates on both positive and negative edges. The top module of the processor incorporates various blocks, including the Arithmetic Logic Unit, Barrel Shifter, Decoder, and Universal Shift Registers. To minimize power consumption, the top module will be implemented in various styles before deciding upon the architecture which uses less power. An Arithmetic Logic Unit is integrated as a forwarding unit, setting this architecture apart from traditional Harvard or Von Neumann architectures. Verilog HDL serves as the foundational language, with comprehensive implementation and analysis of the top module, RTL code, timing diagrams, and Netlist generation performed using the XILINX ISE DESIGN tool.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Smart Crop Recommendation System
abstract: Many challenges are faced by agricultural sector due to various dependent factors like changes in climatic conditions, variation in soil properties and farming practices. What to plant in their agricultural land is the common question for all farmers. Many farmers are failing to identify the crop that suits their agricultural land to get good yields. This results in following the same methods and crops what their ancestors were following. The crop yield always depends on multiple parameters like soil properties, climate conditions, water level etc. So if the farmers get suggestions regarding which crop to grow in their agricultural land would be of great help. The government is also helping farmers in many ways, one such scheme is soil testing. Soil testing is very important because through testing we can identify nutritional level, pH level and moisture level of soil which can optimize crop prediction. To address the above mentioned issues, this paper proposes a Crop Recommendation System(CRS) to help farmers based on machine learning algorithms to take wise decision to select a crop for their agricultural land. The CRS considers historical data, soil type, pH level, season, water level and amount of pesticides to provide crop recommendation for agricultural plots. The CRS system uses Naive Bayes algorithm to select the crop suitability. The CRS is a user friendly system that can be accessed through web or mobile. The user can give necessary input regarding their agricultural land and get crop recommendation which suits their farming land. The proposed system aims to improve crop yield, minimize resources and environmental impact.

articleTitle: Enhancing CAN-FD Security with an Ensemble Learning Approach for Intrusion Detection
abstract: As the integration of advanced technologies in vehicular systems continues to rise, the risk of cyber threats to in-vehicle networks is also becoming a critical concern. Intrusion detection systems (IDS) play a crucial role in safeguarding these networks against unauthorized access and malicious activities. Traditional IDS approaches often face challenges in effectively detecting cyber threats due to the technological advancements in automotive environments. This study proposes an ensemble learning-based intrusion detection model tailored for CAN-FD (Controller Area Network - Flexible Datarate) networks. The model combines the strength and computational simplicity of multiple classification algorithms, including Random Forest (RF), Decision Trees (DT), and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), to create a robust and adaptive detection system. Through comprehensive experimentation and evaluation with the benchmark CAN-FD intrusion dataset, the proposed ensemble model demonstrates the reliability of the model compared to individual classifiers. This research contributes to in-vehicle security by providing an effective and scalable approach to intrusion detection in CAN-FD networks.

Author Keywords: Controller Area Network - flexible Data rate(CAN-FD)

articleTitle: Automatic Detection and Analysis of Concrete Cracks Using YOLO
abstract: This research introduces a novel approach for the automated detection and analysis of concrete cracks using deep learning techniques, with a focus on predicting the lifespan of structures. Concrete infrastructure is susceptible to various forms of deterioration, and cracks are early indicators of potential structural issues. Traditional methods for crack detection and analysis are often time-consuming and subjective. In this study, we utilize deep learning calculations, explicitly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), to distinguish and order breaks in substantial surfaces naturally. The proposed model is trained on a diverse dataset of concrete images, enabling it to generalize across different environmental conditions and crack patterns. Furthermore, the research extends beyond crack detection to predict the potential lifespan of concrete structures. By leveraging historical data on concrete deterioration and utilizing advanced predictive modeling. Based on detected cracks, the system seeks to offer insights into the anticipated durability of structures. This predictive capability serves as a proactive tool for maintenance planning and resource allocation, contributing to the long-term sustainability of civil infrastructure. Our experiments’ outcomes show how well the deep learning model works to identify concrete cracks and forecast possible structural degradation.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Classification of Cervical Cancer using pap smear images
abstract: Cervical cancer, originating in the cervix, poses a significant health concern, ranking as the fourth most diagnosed cancer and leading cause of cancer-related deaths in women. It often remains asymptomatic in early stages, making regular screenings crucial for early detection. Current diagnostic methods involve Pap tests and HPV tests which has challenges in diagnosis which include low screening rates, Pap smear sensitivity, and variability in interpretation. To address challenges, an AI based approach has been done in this paper. The study employs various deep learning architectures, namely ResNet18, ResNet50, GoogLeNet, and SqueezeNet, while carefully considering different epoch settings. The results showease ResNet18 as the top-performing model, attaining the highest test accuracy of 98.51%. The findings emphasize the importance of selecting the appropriate network architecture and training duration, tailored to the characteristics of cervical cancer classification. Future developments in these areas could revolutionize cervical cancer diagnosis, making it more effective and widely accessible.

articleTitle: Understanding Training Behaviour during Transfer Learning by drawing parallels to Grokking
abstract: In the realm of machine learning, understanding how models arrive at their predictions or decisions, known as mechanistic interpretability, is crucial for trust, transparency, and refinement. This involves unraveling the relationships between input features, intermediate representations, and output predictions. One key aspect of mechanistic interpretability is the analysis of attention weights and neural activations in neural network models, which provide insights into the decision-making processes and utilization of learned features. Transfer learning, on the other hand, is a widely used technique in machine learning that involves pre-training a model on one task or dataset and fine-tuning it for another task or dataset. By capitalizing on the transferability of features learned from one domain to another, transfer learning enhances model performance, particularly in scenarios where labeled data is limited. This research paper aims to investigate behavioral patterns trained with and without transfer learning, observing patterns of training, and comparing it with known phenomenon of grokking, we can hypothesize the efficacy of transfer learning during different phases of grokking, through this investigation, the paper aims to contribute to a deeper understanding of transfer learning and its implications for neural network training, with potential implications for improving model performance and real-world applicability.

articleTitle: Memcached’s Redis Repository Benchmark for CRUD Operations
abstract: Every day there are more and more highly loaded applications in the world. Sometimes the response speed of these applications causes inconvenience to users and requires improvement. In this regard, in this paper, we compared two popular repositories designed to speed up the application by reducing the load on the database or file system. As a result of experimental studies, differences in the functionality of data storage operations, such as the speed of creating, reading, changing and deleting records, were presented. A comparison of the execution of CRUD operations using the presented repositories was displayed in the form of graphs and tables. As a result of the experiments conducted, data was obtained showing that the two repositories have similar functionality, but Redis should be used in the case of more complex tasks that require a more sophisticated approach. In turn, Memcached allows you to distribute data across multiple running application servers, as well as easily add new nodes.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning based Two branch model for Automated Recognition and Segmentation of Solar Panels In-flight Imagery
abstract: Due to the repercussions of climate change on the entire planet, reducing greenhouse gas emissions will require teamwork. Since the energy industry is the primary source of climate change emissions, there is a lot of work being done to shift away from power plants that give out carbon towards imperishable energy sources like solar power. To help researchers and policy makers develop plans for the continued growth of solar energy, a thorough database of solar panel locations is essential. The purpose of this research is to identify and build the overall map of solar panel within a geographical area that includes the location and size of the panel. Using aerial photography, deep learning techniques are employed to automatically recognise the placement and surface zone of solar panels. The framework was trained using a dataset of satellite images that were produced specifically for the study. It is a two-section model that combines a semantic segmentation model with an image classifier. With an Intersection over Union(IOU) points of 0.85 for segmentation accomplishment and an accuracy of 0.97 for classification, this work offers a scalable and effective way to detect solar panels.

articleTitle: Design and Development of IoT Enabled Health Monitoring System Using Node MCU
abstract: In recent times, most healthcare establishments are affirmed to be valuable by using Internet of Things (IoT) based monitoring systems. This paper proposes a patient health monitoring system in real-time by utilizing critical care body vitals such as body temperature and pulse rate in an IoT environment. The results are monitored on a liquid crystal display unit synchronized with a device software or a mobile application. The proposed scheme uses ESP32 Node MCU which allows realtime data exchange using the IoT cloud. The obtained results are accurate (error percentage $\lt \pm 5 \%$) when compared to the available medical devices in the market. The developed IoT-based system prototype would play a crucial role in handling emergencies effectively to save lives.

articleTitle: Prediction and Analysis of Fraud Detection in Finance: A Deep Learning and Machine Learning based approach
abstract: Online financial transactions have become an essential part of our everyday lives in this era of digital commerce. But in addition to its convenience, there’s a real risk of fraudulent activity, which could lead to serious financial losses and erode confidence in digital financial institutions. This research project focuses on the creation and evaluation of sophisticated fraud detection algorithms in an effort to address this urgent problem. In addition to traditional machine learning methods, the research makes use of state-of-the-art deep learning models including Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Feedforward Neural Network (FNN), and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) to accomplish this. Large-scale datasets are used to train these models in order to find patterns suggestive of fraudulent transactions. The intricate interplay between transactional data, consumer behavior, and temporal relationships within these deep learning architectures significantly enhances the accuracy and efficiency of fraud detection processes.

articleTitle: LSTM Based Stock Price Prediction on Daily Charts
abstract: The incorporation of fundamental ratios for predicting the stock price, such as price to book (PB), price to sales (PS) and Price to earnings(PE), alongside historical price data has gained considerable attention in stock price prediction. This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of utilizing these fundamental ratios in conjunction with Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) model for predicting stock prices. In particular, we chose three large-cap companies that are listed in the National Stock Exchange (NSE), in India. scripts such as Reliance, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), and Imperial Tobacco Company (ITC) are selected as case studies. Historical price data and fundamental ratios are collected over a specific period of the past year i.e. march 2022 to march 2023. To ensure accurate predictions, the collected dataset undergoes preprocessing techniques. By incorporating both fundamental ratios and historical price data into LSTM model, this study aims to explore the potential benefits of combining these factors for improved stock price prediction in terms of the chosen metrics like Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).

articleTitle: Advancing Urban Evacuation Management: A Real-Time, Adaptive Model Leveraging Cloud-Enabled Big Data and IoT Surveillance
abstract: Emergency evacuation management in urban areas is paramount due to rapid population growth and urbanization. This research introduces an innovative methodology leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) and Big Data Technologies to fortify emergency management systems. This research proposes a system that integrates IoT sensors, an MQTT broker, a Kafka broker, HDFS, and Spark streaming, all housed in the cloud infrastructure, facilitating real-time monitoring and calculation of varying risk scores through each of the exit routes during an emergency and providing the evacuees with a user interface that alerts them with the most probable safety exits. Unlike conventional evacuation systems that focus solely on identifying the shortest exit route, or have a static approach to processing data, our solution minimizes potential risks during an emergency by monitoring factors such as pressure, temperature, humidity and flame intensity in real-time and predicts risk scores for danger-prone exits considering the number of exits and accessibility of each exit, thus notifying the user of the same through a web interface. To illustrate the practical applicability of our system, we present a case study centred around a sports stadium, offering a tangible example of the proposed solution’s effectiveness.

articleTitle: Novel Approach for Security Constrained Optimal Power Flow Solution of Utility Grid Power Network
abstract: This paper presents a study of security constrained optimal power flow to minimize the generation cost while maintaining the system parameters within permissible limits. These parameters include voltage, line power flow, active power and reactive power generation of power plants. A non-linear quadratic cost objective function is formulated considering the active power generated by the generators. MATPOWER interior point solver is used to solve the test network of IEEE-9 bus system to minimize the cost objective function considering security constrained limits of the bus voltages, line power flows and active power generated by the generators. This is established that proposed quadratic cost function is effective to run the system at minimum cost while maintaining the security system limits. Study is performed using the MATPOWER tool of the MATLAB software.

articleTitle: Optimising Energy Management Strategies for Hybrid Electric Vehicles: To Improve Efficiency and Performance
abstract: In this paper, a new optimised energy management approach for a hybrid power system based on batteries and supercapacitors specifically intended for electric cars (EVs) is presented. The suggested approach makes use of optimal differential fatness to efficiently regulate the two energy sources’ power distribution according to load demand. The main goal is to meet the power requirements of a synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) and maximise power quality by minimising current harmonics, which will improve battery longevity. The optimal adaptive differential fatness strategy that has been suggested has significant advantages over traditional strategies. It reduces battery current harmonics, minimises DC-bus voltage ripples and voltage overshoots, and minimises peak currents during acceleration and deceleration phases. By improving the power system’s ability to adjust to unforeseen fluctuations in load, the online updating strategy further increases the system’s robustness and efficiency. The proposed energy management system’s possible applicability to various power systems, such as those incorporating fuel-cell technology in hybrid electric vehicles, is discussed in the paper’s conclusion.

articleTitle: Modelling and Parameter Estimation of Super Capacitor Bank under Balanced and Unbalanced conditions
abstract: Super capacitors(SC) have gained eminence as an energy storage solution due to its high energy density,rapid charging and discharging capabilities and superior life cycle. The recent developments in modelling SCs using fractional order calculus has enabled in better understanding of charge reallocation and dynamics that happens within a SC. This paper extends this Fraction Order Model(FOM) to a $2 \times 2$ SC bank under balanced and unbalanced conditions and verify whether such a bank can be mathematically reduced to a single cell of higher voltage and current capabilities. The parameters of the bank is obtained by curve fitting methods using the experimental and simulated data and compared with the parameters of a single cell.The proposed theory is backed with substantial experimental data obtained from charge-discharge profile of a 2x2 bank of the Faradigm 360F 2.7V each.

articleTitle: Implementation of Load Balancing Algorithms in Software Defined Networks using OpenDaylight
abstract: In today’s world, the pressure on the traditional network infrastructure is on the rise with complex applications and services in use. Software Defined Networks, SDN, can support these changing requirements by providing flexible and centralized management of the network. Load balancing within SDN ensures that the network resources are used wisely, providing better performance, fewer disruptions and the ability to handle changing demands smoothly. This paper explores and simulates load balancing in an SDN environment employing OpenFlow and harnessing the capabilities of OpenDaylight as the SDN Controller. Mininet is utilized to construct a fat tree topology, a popular data center network architecture, to model and analyze load balancing strategies. Two load balancing algorithms namely Round Robin and dynamic load balancing are implemented in this work. The results demonstrates improved performance proving the need for load balancing in network infrastructure as significant.

articleTitle: Yummy YOLO: A Deep Learning Approach Towards Indian Culinary Classification
abstract: Food image classification is a growing research area as it has many advantages, whether in the health sector to maintain a proper diet or in the tourism sector to help tourists know about dishes. In this paper, the authors have compared two approaches to categorize the Indian food images into ten categories. VGG-16, a Convolution Neural Network model, and object detection algorithm YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once, version 8) were used towards the task of Indian food classification and VGG-16 performed with an accuracy of 80.51 %, and the YOLOv8 model out performed with an accuracy of 98.2 %.

articleTitle: Computational Approach for Halegannada to Hosagannada Poem Translation
abstract: Halegannada, or Old Kannada, occupies a pivotal place in Karnataka’s linguistic and cultural tapestry and cultural heritage, embodying a significant epoch in the evolutionary timeline of the Kannada language, with a history spanning over 2000 years. This research pioneers the translation of Halegannada poetry into contemporary Hosagannada, employing cutting-edge Natural Language Processing (NLP) models. Indic languages exhibit a notable scarcity of substantial parallel and monolingual corpora in comparison to English and other European languages. Dravidian languages requires more annotated data compared to European or Indo-European languages. Within the realm of Indic languages, several Dravidian languages are categorized as low-resource languages and Halegannada is one among them. To overcome this limitation, strategies such as Back Translation, Unsupervised Machine Translation, Neural Machine Translation, Unsupervised Neural Machine Translation (UNMT), and Transfer Learning are employed. To overcome the lack of pre processed Halegannada data, a comprehensive dataset comprising 20,000 meanings extracted from Pampa’s architectural work is created. This paper proposes a Halegannada word splitting model based on LSTM and a computational approach for Halegannada to Hosagannada poem translation. The word splitting model has an accuracy of77.92%.

articleTitle: Behavioral Diversity and Individuality in Simulated Agents
abstract: The project centers on addressing critical challenges in multi-agent co-ordination, resource allocation, and ethical decision-making. The primary focus lies in developing novel algorithms and frameworks that enable simulated agents to dynamically adapt and learn from interactions within multi-agent ecosystems. Emphasis is placed on fostering robust collaboration, efficient resource utilization, and ethical decision-making frame-works tailored for diverse scenarios. The research methodology encompasses a blend of theoretical modeling, algorithmic development, and simulation-based experiments. Leveraging state-of-the-art machine learning techniques, the study aims to create adaptable agents capable of effective decision-making in dynamic and uncertain environments. The outcomes of this research project aim to contribute significantly to the field of artificial intelligence, particularly in advancing the capabilities of simulated agents. By fostering adaptability, collaboration, and ethical reasoning within multi-agent systems, this project endeavors to pave the way for more sophisticated and socially-aware artificial intelligence frame-works.

articleTitle: Smart Shopping Cart
abstract: Amidst the ever-shifting tech landscape, businesses and retailers incessantly seek inventive solutions to streamline customer interactions, boost efficiency, and enrich the shopping experience. This study explores the integration of cutting-edge machine learning, Raspberry Pi computing, and automated billing to redefine the traditional point-of-sale process. This study centers on real-time object detection, utilizing cutting-edge models such as YOLO, executed on the versatile Raspberry Pi 4. Customers can engage with the system through a user-friendly touch screen interface, allowing efficient item identification and automated billing via QR codes. This study uncovers the technical intricacies, potential enhancements, scalability, and compliance factors. It explores envision a future where machine learning and edge computing revolutionize retail operations, elevating both customer satisfaction and business efficiency

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Computing Security through Deep Learning and Attention Mechanism Intrusion Detection Systems
abstract: This research investigates the enhancement of cloud computing security through adaptive neural network intrusion detection systems, employing Deep Belief Networks (DBN) and Attention Mechanism. The study aims to address the growing concerns surrounding security threats in cloud environments by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques. Experimental evaluations were conducted to assess the performance of the proposed approach, with specific emphasis on detection accuracy, false positive rate, and computational efficiency. Results indicate that the DBN-based intrusion detection system achieved an average detection accuracy of $94.4 \%$, with a false positive rate of $2.2 \%$ and a computational efficiency of $\mathbf{1 5 8. 4}$ milliseconds. In comparison, the IDS utilizing Attention Mechanism demonstrated superior performance, with an average detection accuracy of $96.2 \%$, a false positive rate of $1.1 \%$, and a computational efficiency of 153.2 milliseconds. These findings underscore the effectiveness of DBN and Attention Mechanism in bolstering the security posture of cloud computing environments. By integrating adaptive neural network-based intrusion detection systems, organizations can enhance threat detection capabilities, mitigate risks, and safeguard sensitive data and critical assets in the cloud.

articleTitle: Implementation of Leading Zero Count (LZC) for Arithmetic and Logic Unit (ALU) Operations
abstract: Leading Zero Count (LZC) plays a crucial role in arithmetic and logic operations (ALU) within digital circuits, both sequential and combinational. LZC refers to the process of determining the number of consecutive leading zeros in a binary number. Both combinational and sequential LZC circuits find extensive usage in digital signal processing tasks, where quick and accurate determination of leading zeros is essential for various operations like normalization, filtering and feature extraction. Furthermore, they are integral components in hardware implementation of algorithms for data compression and encryption, contributing to enhanced efficiency and performance. The design principles, implementation strategies and applications of leading zero count in both combinational and sequential settings, highlighting their significance in modern digital systems. The LZC system is simulated and synthesized using Xilinx ISE tool and implemented on Artix-7 FPGA.

articleTitle: Enhanced Classification of Intel Images Using Refined EfficientNet and MobileNetV2 Frameworks
abstract: The proposed study describes the functioning of two modern deep learning models, namely EfficientNet and MobileNetV2, within the scope of image classification from a wide range of datasets. This study is designed to categorize images into six groups, namely: buildings, mountains, forests, sea/ocean, glaciers, and streets. The study utilizes a dataset from the Kaggle repository to assess the effectiveness of these models. The research methodology will include data preprocessing, modeling, and model evaluation. This paper will find out the balance between accuracy and efficiency which is provided by each model. EfficientNet is compared with MobileNetV2 because of its scalable structure and compromise between model depth, width, and resolution versus the latter which is known for its low weight and efficiency, especially in constrained circumstances. The research utilizes a framework of accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score metrics, and model efficiency analyses for comprehensive result evaluation and scrutiny. The analysis of this study indicates the unique advantages of separate models, for instance, EfficientNet is more accurate in most cases and MobileNetV2 is a good solution when you have to save computer resources. Comparing models highlights the importance of the selection that is made based on the specific application instead of performance metrics or computational demands.

articleTitle: Passive Cell Balancing using PI Controller
abstract: The increasing demand for clean transportation has propelled research and development in electric vehicles (EVs), with a crucial focus on enhancing battery technologies. This paper presents a novel approach to battery management by implementing a passive cell balancing system for lithium-ion battery packs. The proposed system employs a Proportional-Integral (PI) controller to address voltage imbalances among individual cells, aiming to improve battery life and longevity without the need for a complex active control circuit. The research involves a comprehensive review of existing passive balancing techniques, followed by an optimization process to integrate the optimal approach into a real-world battery pack. The study explores performance evaluation under diverse conditions, considering factors such as system capacity retention, energy efficiency, and overall reliability. Safety and thermal management considerations play a crucial role in the implementation, ensuring the longevity and stability of the lithium-ion battery pack. The primary objectives of this research are to extend the operational life of lithium-ion batteries, reduce maintenance costs associated with battery management, and contribute to sustainable energy solutions. The findings from this study are expected to benefit both the environment and consumers by promoting efficient and reliable electric vehicle technologies

articleTitle: A Standardized Method for Identifying and Categorizing Ladyfinger Diseases
abstract: Researchers provide a machine-learning approach that accurately classifies ladyfinger leaf illnesses. A 4380-photo dataset underpins the technique. Ladyfinger leaves in a variety of conditions in this dataset. In the table below, the model’s accuracy, recall, and F1-Score for healthy and unhealthy leaves are impressive. All values exceed $96.39 \%$. Support values show that the dataset is balanced, which helps the model’s generalization. The model’s $97.57 \%$ accuracy in diagnosing ladyfinger leaf illnesses is noteworthy. The macro, weighted, and micro averages show the model’s consistent performance across assessment criteria. This research advances automated plant disease diagnosis, showing how machine learning could improve agricultural processes. This model might help farmers because of its high accuracy and precision. This reliable method for early disease diagnosis and intervention helps apply sustainable crop management practices.

articleTitle: Migration of Idle Machines via Parking Server – a new & sophisticated Ant Colony Optimization algorithm to address Green Cloud Computing
abstract: Cloud computing is a modern concept that includes internet-based computing, as well as the abstraction of hardware devices. It is a convenient on-demand service that can be accessed ubiquitously from any corner of the world.
