articleTitle: Deep Convolutional Neural Network for Improving Intrusion Detection. A Spectogram based NIDS Framework
abstract: In the past few years, computer networks have changed drastically as the number of connected devices and applications increased significantly. Because of the network’s increased scale and our reliance on it for all parts of our lives, hostile parties have launched a slew of new attacks against the network, as well as mutations of existing attacks. When it comes to safeguarding devices and network nodes, along with the data they contain, against possible breaches, these attacks provide a number of challenges for network security professionals. One of the best security solutions is a system to detect network intrusions which continuously monitors network traffic to safeguard network entry points. When it comes to identifying new assaults, the false alarm rate (FAR) for NIDS remains high even after substantial scientific efforts. We introduce a novel architecture for Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) employing a deep convolutional neural network alongside spectrogram images generated through the short-time Fourier transform. The effectiveness of our approach was assessed using the CIC-IDS2018 dataset. Our experimental findings revealed a reduction in False Alarm Rate (FAR) by 4.3

articleTitle: Real-Time Ragging Notification Using Machine Learning Algorithms and MediaPipe
abstract: Ragging is disorderly practice of senior students harassing their juniors that violates rules of the institutions. Addressing critical issues such as ragging, suicidal ideation, and medical emergencies within college campuses necessitates the integration of innovative technological solutions. The utilization of innovative technologies such as MediaPipe and machine learning algorithms plays a pivotal role in addressing critical issues like ragging, suicidal ideation, and medical emergencies within college environments. This research paper integrates OpenCV, machine learning algorithms, MediaPipe, including support vector machine, random forest, k-nearest neighbour, and support vector machine, to develop a model for hand tracking and key point recognition. Through the deployment of a camera-enabled device, real-time footage is captured and compared against the trained model. Predictions and classification is detected from hand gestures, and when the sign matches the designated sign then it triggers an alarm and sends a screenshot of the person who needs help. This ensures prompt alerts authorities to take necessary actions in response to identified situations, thereby enhancing campus safety and welfare.

articleTitle: Real Time Fake news Detection Web App Enhanced by Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: In this era, the pervasive proliferation of fabricated news has come to light as a formidable adversary, corroding the credibility of journalistic sources, sowing confusion, and distorting public discourse. To counteract this escalating predicament, this research introduces a pioneering and comprehensive solution-an interactive web application engineered to detect and mitigate the impact of fabricated news. Through the strategic integration of sophisticated machine learning algorithms, this platform not only identifies spurious news content but also operates in real time, enabling swift responses to the proclamation of misinformation. The key aim of this study is to elevate the precision and efficiency of fabricated news identification. This is achieved through a meticulously devised amalgamation of advanced natural language processing (NLP) techniques, meticulous feature engineering strategies, and the robust framework of ensemble learning methods. The fusion of these techniques equips the system with an arsenal of tools to scrutinize news story, disentangling the intricate web of linguistic nuances that often obscure deceptive content. The real-time facet of the application is pivotal, ensuring that the detection process transpires in sync with the constant influx of news story across digital platforms. This immediacy minimizes the potential amplification of false narratives, thereby curbing the negative impact of fabricated news proclamation. The heart of the system lies in its fabricated news detection capability, fortified by the intricacies of modern machine learning. By training on vast repositories of verified news data and contrasting it with known instances of false information, the algorithms learn to recognize patterns that distinguish authentic news from falsified narratives. Accessed through standard web browsers, the web application interface offers an intuitive and accessible medium for users to engage with the detection process.

articleTitle: Low Grade Glioma Segmentation Using UNET With ResNext50 Backbone
abstract: ALow-grade Glioma is a tumor that arises from the brain’s supporting cells called glial cells and is classified as grade II and III on the World Health Organization’s grading scale. Gliomas are usually benign, but they can develop into tumors that cause severe neurological symptoms and put pressure on surrounding brain tissue. The majority of these tumors are found in adults, but they can also appear in children. Most of these tumors are treated through surgery, radiation therapy or a combination of the two. Patients may also be monitored with close monitoring if they are asymptomatic, but it’s important to note that these tumors can develop into higher-grade tumors over time, so patients should be monitored regularly for any changes in their tumor. Segmentation The process of segmentation is the separation of tumor tissue from surrounding healthy tissue in an MRI scan of the brain.

articleTitle: Smart Helmet with Transparent Display
abstract: The primary aim of the system is to design and implement a Smart Helmet tailored for two-wheeler navigation, integrating an advanced transparent display system. This innovative system overlays critical information, including turn-by-turn directions from prominent navigation such as google maps, directly onto the rider’s line of sight. The incorporation of this transparent display system is carefully designed to enhance situational awareness, allowing riders to concentrate on the road while receiving essential information. Furthermore, the smart helmet will feature Bluetooth technology, facilitating seamless connectivity with the rider’s smartphone. This integration empowers riders to engage in hands-free communication, encompassing tasks such as answering calls, receiving text notifications, and accessing pertinent mobile applications, all without the necessity of helmet removal or external device manipulation. Through the implementation of these sophisticated features, our project endeavors to redefine the riding experience,prioritizing safety, and convenience. By harnessing cutting-edge technology to augment situational awareness and streamline communication, our Smart Helmet aims to enhance rider safety and comfort during two-wheeler journeys.

articleTitle: Neural Network Modelling, Testing, and Simulation Study of an Autonomous Vehicle Using the Udacity Simulator
abstract: Self-driven vehicles, also known as autonomous vehicles, have become an innovative technology with the capacity to completely change the transportation sector. This report offers an in-depth study and implementation of self-driving vehicles. Furthermore, the research aims to evaluate the performance and accuracy of the neural network model using CPU and GPU computational power. It seeks to identify and analyse the difficulties encountered while training and testing the neural network model. Also, some different kinds of image processing are discussed in this paper. This includes exploring the key components of self-driving vehicles, such as perception systems, decision-making algorithms, and control systems. Also, the study aims to provide a brief overview of the current state of research, advancements, and applications related to object detection algorithms and self-driving vehicles. It highlights advancements in self-driving vehicle technologies. Lastly, at the end of this report, the workings of a self-driven vehicle are represented within the two different environments, or tracks.

articleTitle: Transcranial Acoustoelectric of Functional Brain Activity Extraction based on Interet of Things
abstract: Understanding the mind in its normal state is gaining more and more attention. The widespread adoption of practical brain screens, such as functional cerebral oxygenation, or near-Infrared Spectroscopy (fNIRS), uses near-infrared (NIR) light to record the hemodynamic responses of the mind.—was recently spurred by this. Psychiatry, clinical brain research, neuroscience, nervous system science, and clinical settings are among the clinical sectors that use fNIRS these days. When compared to its companion, the more practical functional Attractive Reverberation Imaging (fMRI), functional near-Infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) offers a greater transitory aim to filter the hemodynamic reaction of the brain’s cortical layer. In an unrestricted environment, FNIRS may prove to e an excellent wearable device for brain screening. Similarly, the computation for ongoing design, controlling, and data collection, and signal processing confuse clever, wearable fNIRS. Existing fNIRS frameworks are not intelligent, are fully not wearable, and are not intended to serve as an intelligent hub for a body sensor network (BSN). Using a remote Graphical User Interface (GUI), our unique programmable fNIRS technology acts as a BSN hub in this study. We have provided web of things (IoT) based help located design for the recently announced fNIRS framework, which is dependent on an implanted board and offers the benefits of remote data transfer to the GUI, channel selection, montage setup, fNIRS signal testing, and modification. This work may enhance the adaptability of the fNIRS framework for usage in daily settings where the brain components of moving human beings are observed.

articleTitle: Spam Comment Detection Using the Ensemble Technique
abstract: YouTubeis a highly popular video streaming platform that allows users to share and spread videos covering a wide range of topics, including educational content and entertainment. Its vast collection of user-generated content makes it a popular platform for creators to showcase their storytelling skills and connect with a global audience. Additionally, YouTube’s interactive features, such as comments and likes, provide viewers with the opportunity to engage in discussions and express their appreciation for compelling narratives. However, YouTube’s interactive commenting feature has raised concerns due to spam comments, which can diminish the video’s impact and popularity, often containing irrelevant or promotional content. In this research, we applied feature extraction methods and developed machine learning models using YouTube datasets featuring PSY, Katy Perry, LMFAO, Eminem, and Shakira to detect spam comments. The ensemble of classifiers, including Random Forest (RF), Decision Trees (DT), and Support Vector Machines (SVM), yielded an impressive accuracy rate of $96.68\%$.

articleTitle: Panoptic Segmentation using Mask2Former with Swin Transformers
abstract: In today’s world, there is swift increase in the use of autonomous vehicles. There are different models that are proposed to understand the scene by segmenting and detecting the image into things(objects) and stuff(Background). Mask2Former a novel method for panoptic segmentation that incorporates Swin Transformers as its backbone is the model that is built In the proposed work for better scene understanding. This innovative architecture makes use of the hierarchical representation features of Swin Transformers, a cutting-edge transformer model well-known for its efficiency in handling massive image processing. As a result, it can function as the general-purpose foundation for image classification. The combination of Mask2Former and Swin Transformers provides a powerful approach to difficult segmentation problems, providing excellent accuracy and efficiency inside a single framework. This model significantly beats the best specialized architectures on three widely used datasets the Cityscapes, KITTI and the Coco. Mask2former with swin transformer achieves 64.2percent PQ on coco dataset.

articleTitle: Caption Driven Video Event Detection
abstract: Video activity detection is used in a wide range of applications, such as healthcare, video surveillance, intelligent vehicle systems and more. Recently, the emphasis has shifted to using the power of neural networks to improve the accuracy and effectiveness of activity detection. This paper provides an indepth review of the latest techniques for using neural networks for video activity detection. The paper examines the development of activity detection methods, ranging from traditional statistical approaches to the recent explosion of supervised learning techniques. It focuses on transfer learning, multi instance learning and deep learning methods with a particular focus on convolutions neural network (CNN’s). CNN’s are widely used for their ability to segment humans, to classify and to recognize activity within video sequences or static images. The review covers the entire video activity detection pipeline, from prepossessing and human segmentation to feature extraction and classification. It explains the challenges associated with each step and provides innovative solutions. The paper also discusses the critical role of benchmark data sets as well as simulation tools for evaluating activity detection models. In addition, the paper discusses the challenges that are still present in the field of video activity detection and suggests directions for future research. It emphasises the importance of this field for ensuring public safety and advancing applications in healthcare and surveillance. By summarising the most recent advances and research trends, the purpose of this review is to help researchers and practitioners to develop more efficient video activity detection solutions with neural networks.

articleTitle: Rice Sheath Rot Disease Diagnosis Utilizing Deep Learning: A Wavelet-Filtered Method for Feature Extraction and Analysis
abstract: Rice sheath rot disease is a serious threat to rice production that reduces both the amount and quality of one of the most important food crops farmed globally. This study provides a novel approach to detecting Rice Sheath Rot illness using state-of-the-art deep learning algorithms. It does this by employing a sizable dataset that was collected from several sources, including agricultural institutions, research centers, and first-hand field observations. Our main goal is to develop a trustworthy and efficient diagnostic tool by utilizing cutting edge machine learning and image processing techniques. Our method for pre-processing images starts with the use of wavelet filters. This technique is crucial for removing noise and enhancing the quality of the dataset, which consists of highdefinition images of rice plants suffering from the Sheath Rot disease. Next, sophisticated feature extraction algorithms are used to assess the ill patches’ color, shape, and texture. These qualities are crucial for distinguishing damaged plant tissues from healthy ones. Our main diagnostic model is based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), which have demonstrated effectiveness in image identification and classification applications. The CNN model is trained using the pre-processed and feature-enhanced information, which enables it to identify the intricate patterns and characteristics linked to Sheath Rot sickness. The model’s architecture is designed to optimize efficiency and precision, ensuring prompt and precise diagnosis of illnesses. The suggested approach uses AI and deep learning to help farmers and agronomists detect infections early on and to significantly advance the field of agricultural disease diagnosis. When combined with waveletfiltered pre-processing and CNN-based analysis, our approach sets a new benchmark for the detection and management of Rice Sheath Rot disease. This might lead to more effective disease control strategies and better crop management practices.

articleTitle: Multimodal Fusion for Brain Medical Image Segmentation using MMSegNet
abstract: Multimodal medical image fusion plays a crucial role in integrating information from various imaging modalities, it involves combining data from different models to obtain more and more detailed information, resulting in better diagnostic accuracy compared to using a single model. The need for innovation in this field stems from the importance of semantic medical information (MS-Info) presented in many forms. Effective capture and use of MS-Info leads to better disease identification and diagnosis. In this work, we present a new model for CNN that establishes the relationship between MSInfo and image features to guide inference. The model has two branches; Spatial frequency (SF) (for MR) and grayscale HSV (GV) (PET/SPECT/CT) images used to fuse images by keeping core features to contribute to more detailed disease characterization, ultimately improving patient care and treatment planning. The success of our proposed model has the potential to revolutionize many fields of medical imaging fusion and improve the understanding and diagnosis of various brain diseases.

articleTitle: Fusion of Computer Vision and Natural Language Processing: Automated Image Caption Generation
abstract: In this work the advancement in the field of natural language processing and computer vision, introduces a robust image captioning model that harnesses the capabilities of attention mechanisms. The model encompasses several core components, including the loading and preprocessing of datasets and the integration of MobileNetV3small. The model architecture is designed with a multi-layer transformer decoder, indicating self-attention, and cross-attention mechanisms for a deeper understanding of the image and text data. Training this model involves fine-tuning MobileNetV3small and optimizing the transformer-based decoder for accurate and context-aware caption generation. The utilization of MobileNetV3small and the Transformer-based decoder marks a significant advancement in image captioning, and the model holds promise for applications in automated image description and content generation. The model was tested on diverse datasets, as exemplified by its performance on both the Flicker8k and Conceptual Captions datasets. The training process involves a comprehensive pipeline, encompassing dataset preparation, image feature extraction, and tokenization, ensuring a holistic approach to model learning. The comprehensive result analysis highlighted the enhanced captioning results of the proposed method with CIDEr values of 37.20 and 25.40 on the Flickr8k dataset and conceptual captions dataset.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex Communication in NOMA Energy Harvesting Networks: Performance Assessment
abstract: Full-duplex operation in non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) energy harvesting networks (FDNOE) satisfies the demands of high spectral and energy efficiencies for modern wireless communication. Notwithstanding, securing information in FDNOE has not received considerable attention. This paper firstly proposes a jamming technique to secure FDNOE and then assesses its security performance under realistic consideration of channel information error. Finally, this paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed technique and shows the impacts of numerous specifications on its performance.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection Using Outlier Analysis and Detection
abstract: The prevalence of electronic transactions in financial systems has significantly increased the risk of credit card fraud. Traditional fraud detection methods often struggle to keep pace with evolving fraudulent techniques. This study explores the application of outlier detection techniques as a robust approach to identifying anomalous patterns indicative of fraudulent activities in credit card transactions. Leveraging statistical and machine learning algorithms, this research aims to develop a framework capable of effectively distinguishing between genuine and fraudulent transactions by detecting outliers in transactional data. Through the analysis of various features such as transaction amount, location, time, and user behavior, the proposed method aims to enhance fraud detection accuracy while minimizing false positives. The evaluation of this approach will be conducted on real-world credit card transaction datasets to assess its efficacy in identifying fraudulent activities and its potential for integration into existing fraud prevention systems. This research endeavors to contribute to the enhancement of security measures within financial systems, mitigating financial losses, and bolstering trust in electronic payment systems.

articleTitle: A Secured Online Voting system using Visual Cryptography and Validation
abstract: Phishing poses a substantial threat to online voting, demanding robust prevention methods. Visual Cryptography (VC) offers promise, enhancing security and preserving voting system confidentiality. The Voting System Using VC enables secure remote voting, merging two VC shares to create a unique password—one emailed to voters before the election, the other accessible during the election. This combats phishing, ensuring secure ballot casting. Amid rising phishing risks, innovative prevention techniques are explored, including image-based VC verification and biometric finger sensors. The paper emphasizes internet voting’s security, privacy, and stakeholder involvement, concluding that integrating VC and advanced anti-phishing measures comprehensively secures online voting systems against evolving threats. Additionally, online voting facilitates convenient voting for individuals from diverse locations and aids disabled individuals in casting votes from any place. This emerging field underscores the importance of addressing major threats to ensure the integrity and accessibility of the electoral process.

articleTitle: Demystifying Dementia: A Glimpse Through Univariate and Bivariate Analysis
abstract: Dementia, an umbrella term encompassing a spectrum of neurodegenerative diseases, casts a long shadow on individuals, families, and healthcare systems. Unveiling its intricate tapestry requires a multifaceted approach, and here’s where univariate and bivariate analysis emerge as powerful tools. Univariate analysis, like a detective scrutinizing individual clues, delves into the characteristics of dementia patients. It paints a picture of their demographics, medical history, cognitive performance scores, and even lifestyle habits. But dementia is rarely a solitary culprit. Bivariate analysis, like two detectives collaborating, steps in to examine the interplay between two variables. Imagine scatterplots exploring the association between education level and cognitive decline, or correlation coefficients quantifying the link between depression and dementia severity. This deeper dive uncovers potential risk factors, sheds light on disease progression, and even hints at possible interventions. Univariate and bivariate analysis, though seemingly simple tools, offer a profound window into the complexities of dementia. However, these analyses are just the beginning. They provide crucial insights but don’t paint the whole picture. The true power lies in combining them. Imagine the detective team now armed with both individual clues and their interconnectedness. This holistic approach paves the way for further exploration, potentially leading to the identification of subgroups within the dementia population, tailoring treatment strategies, and ultimately, unlocking new avenues for prevention and early diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Machine and Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Risk Assessment with Diverse Datasets
abstract: Breast cancer, a pervasive global health challenge, demands innovative diagnostic approaches for timely intervention and improved outcomes. This study presents an extensive investigation into the application of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques for breast cancer diagnosis and risk assessment. Utilizing the Wisconsin Breast Cancer Database (WBCD) and the NKI Breast Cancer dataset, our study employs a diverse range of ML models, including Support Vector Machines, Random Forests, Decision Trees, K-nearest neighbors, Naive Bayes, and Logistic Regression, alongside DL models such as Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The investigation incorporates comprehensive data preprocessing, feature selection, and 10fold cross-validation to optimize model performance. Results showease the CNN outperformed with $98.24 \%$ accuracy on the WBCD dataset, while the Decision Tree model leads on the NKI dataset with $91 \%$. Precision, recall, and F1-Score metrics provide a nuanced evaluation of model efficacy. The study not only addresses the limitations of previous works but also introduces a holistic approach, emphasizing the significance of diverse datasets in enhancing breast cancer diagnostic accuracy that holds promise for impactful advancements in healthcare. The findings pave the way for practical applications, including the development of a userfriendly mobile application for personalized breast cancer detection and risk evaluation to foster personalized and timely interventions.

articleTitle: An Advanced Decentralized Architecture enabled Logical Identity based Encryption Logic using Blockchain Assistance
abstract: Using electronic signatures, blockchain technology, and identity-based encryption, essential documents may be certified and electronic contracts can be signed. All of the system’s nodes, operations, and transactions may benefit from blockchain technology’s distributed ledgers. This study introduces a novel encryption system, Decentralized Identity based Encryption Logic (DIEL), and assesses its efficacy by comparing it to the established Identity based Encryption (IBE) scheme. In order to guarantee the privacy and confidentiality of patients’ data in cloud health systems, the suggested technique offers first-rate security using bilinear pairings. Additionally, this strategy authenticates users through challenge-response procedures. Furthermore, the suggested method guarantees the accuracy and integrity of shared data via the use of blockchain technology. Using the standard model, we can confirm that the suggested protocol is valid and that it is secure. Because all nodes are contributing data, cyberspace is more open and behavior can be more easily tracked. Data certification and the contract signing procedure are both finished and in compliance. Users may protect themselves from fraud and identity theft with the help of the Identity based Management system’s encryption features. When used together, these two technologies will provide a safer method of data storage while yet preserving user privacy.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of Deep Learning Models in Personalizing Treatment for Anxiety Disorders
abstract: The current research aims to explore the effectiveness of deep learning models in addressing the problem of treatment personalization for patients struggling with anxiety disorders. The latter have been associated with a wide array of challenges stemming from the varying treatment outcomes to a broad range of symptoms, and personalized treatment is viewed as vital in improving the patients’ prognoses. The research relies on the data of various patients, including those from controlled clinical trials and HER data, to evaluate the effectiveness of DL architectures such as Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as well as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks. The approaches leverage preprocessing and training to minimize the number of treatment response prediction errors and accurately classify the level of anxiety. The results highlight the pressing urgency of developing a new treatment paradigm for anxiety disorders and question the effectiveness of the classic one-fits-all approach. Moreover, the research represents an attempt to bring Deep Learning (DL) algorithms to psychiatry and revolutionize mental health treatment through personalization. The outcomes support that DRL is the most effective at predicting the outcomes and properly classifying anxiety levels with few accurate measures. Overall, the findings confirm the effectiveness of DL models for personalized psychiatry and suggest further opportunities for leveraging them to improve the situation with mental health overall. It is evident that similar efforts can only be successful when theorists and practitioners join forces to achieve major changes, and by offering valuable survey results, the research paves the way to further meaningful dialogue.

articleTitle: Optimizing Cargo Ship Operational Costs: A Comprehensive Algorithmic Approach
abstract: Cargo ships are essential in global trade, and their operational expenses strongly influence the economic sustainability of shipping companies. The objective is to minimize the total cost function, expressed as 0.2(x2) + (450/x),, where ‘x’ represents the ship speed. The study explores the optimal ship speed within the specified constraints of 0.5 m/s to 25.5 m/s using algorithms such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Simulated Annealing, Stochastic Gradient Descent, and Newton’s Method. Performance metrics, including Mean Squared Error (MSE), R-squared, and convergence plots, are employed to assess the efficiency of these optimization strategies. The research depicts that Newton’s Method outperforms others based on comprehensive metric analysis. The findings contribute valuable insights to streamline cargo ship fleet management, offering practical solutions for improving economic sustainability in the maritime industry.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of the pre-trained models for Brain Tumor Diagnosis
abstract: Brain tumors are a significant health problem worldwide requiring accurate and timely diagnosis for efficient treatment planning. Medical imaging, especially magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed tomography (CT), is important towards recognizing and classifying brain tumors. Traditional approaches to classifying brain tumors typically require radiologists to manually review images, a process that is protracted, laborious and prone to mistakes. Continuing advances in medical imaging technology are optimizing the early detection and diagnosis of various diseases, including brain tumors. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are gaining importance in this tool set for automatic image analysis and classification. This research paper delves into the application of CNNs for brain tumor categorization, exploring their effectiveness in improving accuracy and efficiency in comparison to traditional methods. The models undergo training with a dataset consisting of 7023 MRI images of the human brain, categorized into four classes: meningioma, pituitary, glioma and no tumor. The networks implemented in our research are ResNet-50, EfficientNetB0, VGG16, AlexNet, and DenseNet. In particular, the pre-trained ResNet-50 model from CNN exhibited excellent results, with an accuracy during training reaching while the validation accuracy stood at $\mathbf{9 8 . 4 4 \%}$.

articleTitle: From Pixels to Prognosis: Exploring from UNet to Segment Anything in Mammogram Image Processing for Tumor Segmentation
abstract: Breast cancer, is the most prevalent form of cancer among women globally accounting for nearly one in four of all new cancer cases. This high prevalence makes breast cancer the second leading cause of death among women making early detection of breast cancer crucial for reducing mortality rates. Mammography, a widely employed medical imaging technique, emerges as a front-line defense against breast cancer. The research aims to achieve pivotal objectives: Firstly, to examine the Segment Anything Model (SAM), created by MetaAI in 2023, and also discuss the model’s use in medical image segmentation. Secondly, the study aims to conduct a comprehensive comparative analysis of SAM’s segmentation capabilities with other existing segmentation models for medical images. The unique strength of the research lies in incorporating both mass and calcification mammograms within the diverse Curated Breast Imaging Subset of DDSM (CBIS-DDSM) dataset this acknowledges the varied nature of breast cancer, exposing the segmentation models to a wide range of scenarios. Through augmenting the dataset with vertical, horizontal, and rotational transformations, this enables accurate identification and isolation of Region of Interests (RoIs) in mammograms, for robust model training for real-world breast cancer diagnosis. The study investigates different segmentation models for medical image segmentation, with an emphasis on prompt-based (SAM), Encoder-Decoder (UNet, UNet++, Attention-UNet, SegNet) models. The study extends to evaluating these models based on Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) such as Dice score, Intersection over Union (IoU) and Accuracy. The insights gained from this research have broader implications for the application of more accurate segmentation in medical image analysis, and making a significant contribution to the continuous efforts to improve breast cancer diagnostic methodologies.

articleTitle: Document Image Analysis for Text Extraction and Translation
abstract: Document Image Analysis (DIA) is an essential tool for text extraction and translation from a variety of language-based images, particularly Tamil and English. This study addresses the difficulties involved in text extraction from document photographs and subsequent translation by providing a thorough examination of methods used in this field. The study focuses on handling difficult scripts and explores several techniques such as image preprocessing, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), and machine translation. It highlights the effectiveness of these methods, particularly in handling complex scripts like Tamil. The study emphasizes how reliable language models and neural networks can improve the precision of text extraction and translation. This idea proposes a system designed specifically for project reports to overcome current constraints and offer a reliable, user-friendly alternative. It presents novel techniques to guarantee precise text extraction and smooth translation while maintaining the format and integrity of the document. By providing an overview of the status of DIA for English-to-Tamil text extraction and translation, this study opens the door for further developments in this rapidly developing subject.

articleTitle: TL-AGRO: Transfer Learning-based Perilous Insect Detection Framework for Smart Agriculture Underlying Edge Computing
abstract: Remote sensing (RS) technology has revolutionized agriculture by harnessing advanced satellites with exceptional temporal and spatial resolution capabilities. These satellites capture Earth’s emitted energy and employ specialized sensors for data collection. Pre-processing techniques refine this data, which is seamlessly integrated into the Edge Device TL-AGRO AI system, transforming precision agriculture. Simultaneously, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have become vital tools, capturing high-resolution data for plant ecology and Perilous farm insect detection. Our proposed framework TL-AGRO is an advanced agricultural analytics method that leverages meticulously preprocessed data to make precise predictions. It detects insects on agricultural properties and provides accurate classification using CNN Architectures, such as Visual Geometry Group 16 (VGG16), Xception Version 2 (XceptionV2), Residual Network 50 Version 2 (ResNet50V2), and Mobile Network Version 2 (MobileNetV2). Integration of coordinated alert system offers timely recommendations and warnings, empowering farmers to make informed decisions and mitigate insect-related risks. TL-AGRO can even identify individual insect infestations and recommend suitable pesticides, revolutionizing farming with an integrated framework that enhances productivity and sustainability. Performance evaluation of TL-AGRO includes various metrics such as accuracy and loss curves, confusion matrix, F1-score, recall and precision, demonstrating its effectiveness in advancing smart agriculture and ecological studies.

articleTitle: Student Attendance Tracking Management using Face Biometric Smart System
abstract: The “Face Recognition-Based Smart Attendance Management System” proposes an innovative solution for automating attendance tracking in educational and corporate settings. This system employs a series of pre-processing techniques including face alignment and illumination normalization to enhance the quality of input images. Feature extraction is achieved through the utilization of deep learning methods such as Transductive Support Vector Machine (TSVM) and Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) for capturing facial landmarks and unique features. The recognition stage utilizes state-of-the-art algorithms like FaceNet and VGGFace to accurately identify individuals, ensuring efficient and accurate attendance management with real-time data updates. In addition to its robust feature extraction and recognition techniques, the system incorporates data storage and management components, making it capable of maintaining a comprehensive database of student or employee attendance records. Through continuous learning and adaptation, the system ensures consistent performance across varying lighting conditions and poses. Furthermore, it can provide real-time feedback to instructors or administrators, facilitating swift responses to attendance irregularities. This smart attendance management system not only simplifies record-keeping but also enhances security and accountability, offering a reliable and efficient solution for attendance monitoring in diverse educational and professional environments.

articleTitle: Exploring Sarcasm Detection: Leveraging Neural Network Models with BERT Embeddings
abstract: Sarcasm is a form of verbal mockery, which poses a unique challenge for common people to understand, this also leads to difficulties in Natural Language Processing and sentiment analysis. This study deals with Sarcasm detection from textual data and a few machine learning and ensemble models were compared with the proposed Deep Learning architecture. BERT was used for the extraction of features and vectorization of textual data. The study utilizes curated datasets consisting of non-sarcastic and sarcastic samples sourced from Kaggle and Reddit platforms. The models will be evaluated using standard metrics. The best ML model accuracy achieved was 0.88 and an F1 score of 0.89 with a combination of Bert Embeddings and the SVM model. The proposed methodology using BERT embeddings a simple neural architecture achieved an accuracy of 0.92 on the test dataset with a F1-score of 0.91. It has a far lesser complexity than other well-known Deep learning architectures in use in other works. With the live streaming of The proposed Neural Network model achieved an accuracy of 0.94 and an F measure of 0.90 on the data streamed from Reddit.

articleTitle: AI Lip Reader Detecting Speech Visual Data with Deep Learning
abstract: Introducing an AI-driven lipreading system adept at decoding speech across diverse languages, including English, Tamil, and Telugu. Leveraging a deep learning architecture comprising a 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3DCNN) with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) units, the model achieves remarkable accuracy in transcribing spoken words solely from visual cues provided by lip movements. Addressing critical accessibility needs, this system holds promise for applications in assistive technologies and human-computer interaction systems. Through rigorous experimentation and evaluation, the lipreading model demonstrates an impressive overall accuracy of 98.4%, underscoring its efficacy and robustness in recognizing spoken words across multiple languages. Advanced evaluation techniques, including ROC curves, confusion matrices, and classification reports, provide comprehensive insights into the model’s performance, enabling targeted refinements and optimizations. This work represents a significant advancement in the field of lipreading, offering a valuable contribution to multimodal communication and fostering inclusivity in diverse linguistic contexts.

articleTitle: User-driven Relevant News Update System (U.R.A.N.U.S)
abstract: In an era characterized by information overload,the need for effective news recommendation systems has become paramount. This review paper provides a comprehensive ex-amination of the methodologies, challenges, and advancements in the domain of news recommendation systems. It explores two primary technologies commonly employed in recommender systems: information filtering and collaborative filtering, elu- cidating their respective features, advantages, and limitations. The paper delves into the application of these technologies in personalized news reading applications, such as PIN, WebClip- ping2, and GroupLens, highlighting their unique approaches to user modeling and recommendation generation. Additionally, it discusses the integration of hybrid methods, which combine information filtering and collaborative filtering techniques, to enhance recommendation quality. The review also addresses key issues in user modeling, including the dynamic nature of user interests and the incorporation of temporal aspects in profile construction. Ethical considerations, such as fairness, diversity, and privacy, are examined in the context of news recommendationsystem design. Through a thorough analysis of performance metrics and comparative studies against baseline models, the paper evaluates the efficacy of various news recommendation approaches. Finally, it identifies future research directions and potential areas for innovation in the field, paving the way forthe development of more sophisticated and user-centric newsrecommendation systems.

articleTitle: Synergistic Skin Cancer Classification: Vision Transformer alongside MobileNetV2
abstract: Skin cancer is one of the most common types of cancer in the world, and it poses major health risks due to its ability to spread quickly and metastasize. Early and accurate identification is crucial for treatment success and improved patient outcomes. This proposed work combines the MobileNetV2 and Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures to create a hybrid automated skin cancer classification technique. This technique aims to increase the accuracy and efficiency of dermatological diagnosis tools by combining MobileNetV2’s effective feature extraction capabilities with ViT’s self-attention mechanism. After testing on the HAM10000 dataset, this hybrid model outperformed individual models with a remarkable $96.3 \%$ classification accuracy. Not only did the integration of ViT and MobileNetV2 improve the classification accuracy but it also demonstrated how various deep-learning architectures work together to tackle complex image analysis tasks. Classifying skin cancers is critical to the medical industry because it allows for the early diagnosis of various dermatological disorders, allowing prompt intervention and treatment. These benefits can eventually improve patient outcomes and save lives in huge numbers. The findings of this research highlight the potential of deep learning to transform dermatological diagnostics and open the door to creating systems that will significantly impact clinical practice by detecting skin cancer with greater accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Enhanced Credit Card Fraud Detection: A Machine Learning Approach
abstract: With the swift advancement in technology, credit cards are increasingly prevalent as substitutes for cash in daily transactions. This presents several opportunities for unscrupulous individuals to use credit cards fraudulently. 425,977 reports of credit card fraud were made in 2023, according to a Federal Trade Commission report. The credit card issuer ought to offer a service that shields customers from potential risks to guarantee their safety when using these cards. To address the problem of class imbalance, we resampled the dataset using the Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique (SMOTE). The following variety of machine learning methods were applied to assess this framework using a soft voting mechanism: Combination 1 consists of KNN, Bagging, AdaBoost, and Logistic Regression, whereas Combination 2 consists of Random Forest, KNN, Bagging, and XGBoost. Furthermore, the usefulness of Logistic Regression, KNN, and AdaBoosting individually was evaluated to determine their stand-alone performance. This comparison served as a benchmark against which the ensemble models were evaluated. The models’ accuracy, F1 score, and Area Under the Curve (AUC) were used to evaluate them. Additionally, the outcomes of the machine learning models combined produced better results, with a total accuracy of 99.81% for combination 1 and 99.86% for combination 2 compared to the individual predictions of the models. However, Combination 2 outperformed Combination 1 in terms of F1 score, suggesting enhanced overall recall and precision performance.

articleTitle: Smart AI Voice Assistant through Generative Text Transformer and NLP Implementation in Python
abstract: In our project, we employed Natural Language Processing (NLP), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative Text Transformer (GTT), and Speech Recognition technologies. Through the utilization of these advanced technologies, we aimed to enhance the capabilities and functionalities of our system. NLP facilitated improved language understanding and interaction, while AI contributed to the overall intelligence and decision-making processes. GTT played a crucial role in generating coherent and contextually relevant text, adding a layer of sophistication to our applications. Additionally, the integration of speech recognition technology enabled seamless interaction through voice commands, enhancing the overall user experience. By leveraging these cutting-edge technologies synergistically, our project aimed to deliver a more intelligent, efficient, and user-friendly system, showcasing the transformative potential of combining NLP, AI, GTT, and speech recognition in an integrated framework. This potent blend transcends mere functionality, aiming to transform user experience and pave the way for intelligent companions seamlessly integrated into our lives. By leveraging the transformative power of this unified framework, we envision a future where technology not only serves us but also empowers and enriches our interactions with the world around us.

articleTitle: Utilizing Deep Learning for Textual Classification of Hate Speech in Online Social Networks
abstract: In today’s digital age, the internet has allowed people from different corners of the world to easily share their ideas. It is a fairly ubiquitous opinion that everybody must have the basic human right to share their opinion and express their thoughts and feelings. However, with this heightened connectivity, people tend to abuse their rights. People often send abusive or racist remarks over the internet, often anonymously. While research on hate speech detection is growing rapidly and diversely, detecting hate speech remains a difficult task. This paper proposes a deep learning model to detecting abuse and hate speech on online social networks. We first start by cleaning the data and then obtain the sentence embeddings using the BERT model. After this, we pass our sentence embeddings to our custom Convolutional Neural Network model to classify the tweets. We optimize the performance of our custom Convolutional Neural Network model by applying the GridSearch technique for hyperparameter tuning. This custom model has a superior performance to baseline Machine Learning Models. We have evaluated the performance of our model on the Hate Speech and Offensive Language dataset.

Author Keywords: Hate Speech and Offensive Language Dataset

articleTitle: IoT Integration and XGBoost Modeling for Faster Gas Station Service
abstract: Businesses must optimize service delivery to compete in today’s fast-paced environment. Gas stations and fuel hubs are under pressure to improve efficiency and customer service. This study suggests integrating the Internet of Things (IoT) with XGBoost modeling to simplify gas station operations and speed up service. First, IoT sensors are strategically placed across the gas station infrastructure to monitor fuel levels, traffic movement, and customer lines in real time. This thorough data gathering creates a dynamic operating environment for proactive decision-making. Second, XGBoost, a strong machine learning algorithm, analyzes IoT data to forecast consumer demand and traffic trends. XGBoost predicts accurately using past data and various factors, enabling resource allocation and service planning. Gas station operators profit from IoT and XGBoost modeling. Predictive maintenance speeds up fix and reduces downtime. It optimizes staffing plans to ensure enough workers during peak hours to speed up service. It also allows consumer behavior analysis-based, tailored marketing. The suggested method allows gas stations to adjust to shifting demand patterns, improve operational efficiency, and provide quicker, better service. Gas stations may lead in service and innovation by integrating IoT and sophisticated analytics.

articleTitle: Handwritten Digit Recognition of MNIST Dataset using Residual Network and Visual Geometry Group Network
abstract: In this work, two different deep learning architectures Residual Network (ResNet) and VGG Network are implemented for the MNIST digit recognition challenge. With a changed architecture, the ResNet which was initially created for challenging image identification tasks is tailored to the more straightforward MNIST dataset. Remaining blocks in the ResNet allow the network to learn hierarchical characteristics effectively. Furthermore, repeated 3x3 convolutional layers are used in an adaptation of the VGG architecture, which is well known for its simplicity and efficiency. Accuracy metrics and visualizations are used to assess the performance of both models after they have been trained and assessed on the MNIST dataset.With the potential for additional optimization and expansion to more complicated datasets, the code that is provided provides a fundamental framework for investigating and comprehending the use of ResNets and VGG Networks in the context of digit recognition task.

articleTitle: Tomato Leaf Disease Detection using Federated Learning
abstract: Early detection of leaf diseases aids in timely invention by farmers, thereby preventing the spread of the disease and minimizing crop loss. Machine learning techniques are applied to detect discoloration lesions, spots, and other abnormalities associated with the diseases. Automated leaf disease detection provides the farmer with valuable data insights that aid in yield optimization. In this paper, a federated learning technique is applied for tomato leaf disease detection to ensure data privacy while enhancing the global model by training models on numerous decentralized devices or servers that hold local tomato leaf disease samples. The proposed system addresses concerns related to security, making it suitable for agricultural applications where sensitive data is involved. The model’s performance is assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The findings demonstrate consistently high performance, with overall accuracy for all clients and classes ranging from 98% to 99%. The precision, recall, and F1 score values are above 94%, indicating that the model can accurately identify images of healthy and diseased tomato leaves with minor misclassification. By utilizing federated learning to create a CNN model for tomato leaf disease classification, this study demonstrates the effectiveness of federated learning in producing accurate models while protecting data privacy.

articleTitle: Futuristic Trends Toward Connected Autonomous Vehicles in Hybrid Vehicular Networks
abstract: Effective communication in vehicular networks is essential for realizing the potential benefits of intelligent transportation systems, including improved safety, reduced congestion, and enhanced overall traffic management. Ongoing research and development continue to advance the capabilities and reliability of communication technologies in this domain. The available literature papers contain a number of proposed techniques for reliable communication for content distribution in vehicular networks. This paper presents the state of art for existing communication techniques along with the upcoming future trends for content distribution in vehicular networks. The motivation behind this work is to provide the audience with the required understanding of the content dissemination in various types of vehicular networks highlight with potential opportunities and challenges, and also investigating the recent studies available in reputed resources directed towards the domain of content dissemination in vehicular networks.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Lesion Detection in Colposcopy Images using Masking
abstract: Numerous research papers have utilized Faster RCNN and Mask R-CNN for cervical cancer lesion detection. However, a common limitation across these studies is the lack of detail regarding the masking approach. This gap motivated us to develop a method for masking. We formulated a manual architecture for masking, distinct from deep learning models. Our model was validated against a deep learning model (Faster R-CNN), achieving an impressive 95% accuracy rate. Given the critical importance of early cervical cancer detection, especially supported by Pap smear tests and HPV screening, our approach fills a significant research void. While colposcopy provides detailed examination, its images are often underutilized in segmentation and masking tasks, highlighting a clear gap in existing methodologies. Our algorithm combines segmentation and masking, enhancing lesion detection in colposcopy, aiding diagnosis, and treatment planning. The resulting output image represents a substantial leap forward in lesion detection, potentially facilitating earlier interventions in cervical pathology.

articleTitle: Alpha Node: Smart Data Retrieval System Using Network Simulator (NS)-3
abstract: Today, networking is the core of modern communication and connectivity. The reality is that it is the underlying framework for data and resource exchanges across various types of computing devices. Alpha node (cluster head) selection, a crucial factor in optimizing networks of groups comprising nodes that can work cooperatively in a localized environment, takes the highest place in the clustered networks hierarchy. The behavior and competence of the alpha node, the most central and leading node of any cluster, profoundly impacts the network’s capacity to coordinate its activities and allocate resources effectively. This study investigates the integration of machine learning methods into the ns-3 simulation framework, i.e., a discrete event simulator with many complicated features. This paper aims to provide the theoretical basis and solutions for managing clustered networks, particularly tree networks. The research will concentrate on combining machine learning models and simulations employing a machine learning model that crystallizes all methods of alpha nodes with a particular eye on the efficiency and quality of alpha node selection. This is aimed at adding significant flow into the network optimization practice.

articleTitle: An Enhanced EfficientNet-Powered Wildlife Species Classification for Biodiversity Monitoring
abstract: Monitoring wildlife species is crucial for understanding and conserving biodiversity, but efficiently identifying these species across vast natural habitats poses a substantial challenge. The existing deep learning architectures like Inception and AlexNet have drawbacks due to their higher computational demands, which could limit their use in resource-restricted settings. This project leverages the power of EfficientNet, a cutting-edge deep learning architecture, to revolutionize wildlife species classification. The proposed Efficient Model has the limitation of fixed scaling coefficients, resulting in diminishing of accuracy gain. By employing transfer learning methodologies, we fine-tune pre-trained EfficientNet models using expansive datasets comprising diverse wildlife species images. Utilizing advanced preprocessing methods alongside EfficientNet’s capabilities, such as feature normalization and adaptive learning rates, contributes significantly to accuracy gain by refining model robustness. EfficientNet architecture, by employing advanced techniques such as data augmentation and attention mechanisms play a pivotal role, not only in elevating species classification accuracy but also in significantly reducing the computational resources and processing time required. This innovative approach holds immense promise for expediting the cataloging of wildlife, thereby fostering advancements in biodiversity monitoring and benefiting conservation initiatives.

articleTitle: MediBot: Revolutionizing Healthcare with IoT-Based Autonomous Medication Management and Smart Cart Facility
abstract: In modern healthcare, the integration of technology has played a pivotal role in elevating patient care standards and streamlining operational workflows. This research focuses on developing the Medication Delivery Cart (MediCart), an autonomous and innovative solution that combines robotics and advanced mapping algorithms seamlessly. This cuttingedge technology aims to transform medication delivery and surgical support within healthcare facilities. The MediCart boasts a robust autonomous navigation system, leveraging a combination of sensors and sophisticated mapping algorithms. This system ensures the safe and efficient transportation of medications from the pharmacy directly to the patient’s bedside. The cart guarantees precise delivery through realtime data processing and monitoring, significantly reducing the potential for medication errors and enhancing overall patient safety. In addition to its primary role in medication delivery, the versatility of the MediCart extends to the operating theater, where it serves as a valuable surgical assistant. Particularly noteworthy is its contribution during the challenging circumstances posed by COVID-19. The MediCart proves invaluable when proximity poses a risk to healthcare professionals. By providing specialized instruments, supplies, and critical realtime data to surgical teams, the MediCart enhances surgical precision, reduces procedural time, and minimizes the necessity for human intervention within the sterile field. This extension further underscores the transformative impact of MediCart in addressing contemporary healthcare challenges and advancing patient-centered care paradigms.

articleTitle: GlucTeleAI: ML-assisted Preliminary Diabetes Assessment Framework for Telemedicine Systems
abstract: The healthcare industry is experiencing a radical transition in this age of fast technology innovation, with telemedicine emerging as a significant paradigm. Telemedical techniques have become more widespread, including teleprescription for delivering medicine to remote locations and telesurgery for performing surgical operations from a distance. Tele-diabetes checks are an essential element for physicians in this setting. We present a sophisticated framework GlucTeleAI that utilizes Machine Learning (ML) to accurately evaluate pre-diabetes such as Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbour, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Support Vector Machine. This comprehensive evaluation guarantees the effectiveness of the system in precisely detecting diabetic patients inside the telemedicine setting, establishing the basis for improved remote healthcare treatments. The performance of models is thoroughly assessed using essential measures such as accuracy, F1-score, recall, and precision. The performance evaluation includes metrics such as precision-recall, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve, and confusion matrix. GlucTeleAI considerably improves the advancement of telehealth and establishes the basis for improved standards in remote healthcare.

articleTitle: Chaotic Leader Particle swarm optimization (CL-PSO) for efficient data storage in a cloud-based Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS)
abstract: There are numerous challenges associated with storing data in the Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) that must be overcome to ensure reliable and efficient operation. Effectively monitoring data replication across numerous nodes to decrease storage overhead and assure fault tolerance is a major challenge. Furthermore, it is essential to address problems of individual Data Nodes while preserving the consistency of the data. Maintaining enough data replication in the data nodes and balancing cluster resources are necessary for optimizing data locality and performance. Chaotic leader Particle Swarm Optimization (CL-PSO) is a stochastic optimization technique that is inspired by the social behavior of bird flocking is used to optimize the distribution of data blocks efficiently ensuring the data availability and reduced latency across a cluster of data nodes in a HDFS The simulation outcomes demonstrate that the storage approach utilizing CL-PSO effectively identifies optimal data nodes and places data blocks with an ideal replication factor. Consequently, this optimization leads to decreased network bandwidth usage within the rack, resulting in reduced read and write latency. Moreover, it enhances data availability and delivery ratio % by comparing the different replication factors of data block storage within the data nodes of the racks.

articleTitle: Job Candidate Eligibility Prediction using Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: The foundation of the applicant selection process is the candidate eligibility criteria. All applications must go through some evaluation process to get selected for a job. Without the use of a machine learning algorithm, the traditional method can require a great deal of time and work from the recruiter and force candidates to wait weeks or months for their results, depending on how many applications there are. It can be completed in a couple of minutes or even seconds with the help of machine learning algorithms. For employees who need this data to decide whether the applicants qualify, this enhancement may prove to be a significant benefit even though there are additional factors to take into account, such as fraud prevention and background checks. Applying convolution neural network to these kinds of challenges has produced quite encouraging outcomes. In this work, we attempt to apply Convolutional Neural Network integration to candidate eligibility cases using a probabilistic technique. The result shows that this technique is suitable for the scenario that requires only two states—approved or rejected-because it could generate binary classified output. Our project aims to implement Convolutional Neural Network and iterate on the approach by adjusting the approach of the network.

articleTitle: Design & Development of NOx Control Diagnostics for Piped Natural Gas Engines
abstract: Alternate fuel - Piped Natural Gas (PNG) Engines are considered today as a leading novel candidate for prime-movers in power generation application. The study and development of Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) control diagnostic (NCD) malfunction strategies involves thorough study and analysis of NOx control diagnostic system’s functioning. These studies are done using experimentation and mathematical modelling with thorough knowledge of system components, sensors and actuators. Among the vital elements of future worthiness is the obligingness with the emission Standards (especially on Nitrogen Dioxides) which will require exact control of NOx control diagnostic system’s functioning. NOx control diagnostic system can be considered to comply with Centre Pollution Control Board (CPCB) emission regulations. This paper proposes a dedicated model-based NOx control diagnostic system’s malfunction detection for PNG Engines. The objectives of simulation and modelling of NCD system includes implementation of NCD on-board the engine which has the capability of: Detecting a NOx control malfunction; Identifying likely cause of NOx control malfunctions by means of information stored in computer memory and/or communicating that information off-board. This document has accordingly been prepared to comprehensively cover requirements of NOx Control Diagnostic for Positive Ignition (PI) base engines.

articleTitle: Effect of Filtering Techniques in Biomedical Hyperspectral Microscopic Images
abstract: A hyperspectral image (HSI) is a 3D hypercube that incorporates spatial and spectral data. It’s an emerging optical imaging method especially in the field of medical imaging, allowing detailed introspection of the spectral data from biological tissues. However, this imaging technique is susceptible to various types of noise, such as thermal noise, speckle noise, Poisson noise, and Gaussian noise. This research article investigates the denoising of hyperspectral images in a multidimensional choledochal liver bile duct cancer dataset that is publicly available in kaggle. Initially, we synthetically add different types of noises to the original data. The noise is then removed using various filters, and the denoising performance is evaluated based on several metrics. The results of this study provide information regarding the efficiency of multiple filters in reducing noise in HSI.

articleTitle: Low Power and High-Speed ECG Compression using Dynamic Threshold
abstract: This work presents an idea of an effective approach to compress the ECG signal and to save the storage space and transmission time. The proposed method has used linear prediction technique with dynamic threshold which is able to achieve a lossless bit compression of 4.84. The parameters like gate count, power consumption, time are taken into consideration for analyzing the behavior of the system. The design is appropriate for low power applications of today since it has a low power consumption and operates at a clock rate of 1.879 ns. The design has a reduced cell area of 426.135 as the number of primitives and black box usage are 13 for BELS (Basic Element of Logic), 11 for Flip-Flops and latches, 1 for clock buffers and 21 for IO buffers. The device utilization has also been reduced according to the device utilization summary. An efficient and low power VLSI design has been presented. The core area is reduced by using the proposed method and the core of chip consumes 0.21 mW of power and the work is implemented in Xilinx and 90 nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning based Hybrid Optimum Route Identification Scheme in WSN
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) has gained lot of interest for researchers especially in monitoring and surveillance applications. Due to limited energy in sensor nodes has created challenge in transmitting the sensed data to base station by developing appropriate routing scheme. Considering the major issues of minimizing energy consumption and maximizing network lifetime, this work proposes a hybrid energy efficient Reinforcement Learning (RL) based optimal route identification scheme for WSN. RL based Q-learning algorithm is used to determine the probable next hop in the route considering degree of connectivity, link quality and available bandwidth. Gravitational Search Algorithm is applied to fine tune the routing choices using fitness function. Q value, residual energy and distance from base station to cluster head are used to derive the fitness function for GSA. Performance effectiveness of the proposed work is validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: Deep Learning For Enhanced Detection and Characterization Of Pulmonary Nodules
abstract: This study aims to develop, an effective customized Convolutional Neural Network model that can accurately identify areas on CT scans that have lung nodules and those that do not. The study utilizes two datasets, the LUNA-16 dataset for training and the IQ-OTH/NCCD dataset for testing. Additionally, we employ a U-Net model for precise lung nodule segmentation. This segmentation approach aimed to achieve a comprehensive characterization of nodules based on their spatial characteristics. The testing phase involves evaluating the performance of our trained models on the IQ-OTH/NCCD dataset, particularly focusing on localizing nodules in malignant cases. Overall, the research highlights the effectiveness of deep learning in early detection and diagnosis of lung cancer. This work contributes to improving the accuracy and reliability of automated pulmonary nodule detection systems, with a focus on identifying nodules in patients with suspected malignancies.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Seizure Determination Combining Brain and Heart Signal Analysis and Training
abstract: Epilepsy is a serious ongoing neurological problem, can be identified by investigating the mind cues delivered by cerebrum neurons. Neurons are associated with one another in a mind¬¬-boggling manner to speak with human organs and produce signals. The checking of these mind cues is ordinarily done utilizing Electroencephalogram (EEG) [5] and Electrocorticography (ECOG) media. These signs are intricate, loud, non-straight, non-fixed and produce a high volume of information. Worldwide, epilepsy influences roughly 50 million individuals, with 100 million being impacted no less than once in the course of their life. By and large, it represents 1% of the world’s weight of sicknesses, and the predominance rate is accounted for at 0.5-1%. The principal side effect of epilepsy is to encounter more than one seizure by a patient. It causes an unexpected breakdown or uncommon movement in the mind that driving forces a compulsory change in a patient’s way of behaving, sensation, and loss of fleeting cognizance. Consequently, the recognition of seizures and revelation of the cerebrum related information is a difficult undertaking. In this manner, the proposed framework gives a viable answer for anticipate the location of epilepsy capture of joining cerebrum heart signal in a more productive manner. In order to determine whether seizures are present at an early stage in this project, we will use AI calculations as gathering models, such as Irregular Backwoods, SVM, and Strategic Relapse. The datasets will be extracted from the Physio Net dataset and processed using AI calculations, culminating in the creation of a model document. When information is provided for the possibility of seizures, it can accurately determine whether epilepsy seizures are present and can lead to the development of effective therapy. Thus, our endeavor contributes to a feasible examination of the seizure assurance of combining the cerebrum [6] heart with motioning, more precisely than the existing models.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Autism Spectrum Disorder using Machine Learning Techniques*
abstract: This thesis examines autism spectrum disorder (ASD) forecast with advanced machine learning methods, specifically gradient enhancement models, neural networks, and a hybrid model combining them. The overall goal is to increase prediction accuracy in Identifying ASD, to facilitate early intervention and support. Our experimental findings reveal that by exploiting the strengths of gradient enhancement and neural network, the combined model achieved the best overall accuracy of 86.875% notably that is, both individual models showed adequate cross-validation accuracy, with gradient enhancement 84. 125 % and neural network 85. 125 %. The findings demonstrate how well machine learning techniques work to comprehend the intricacy of 19th-century ASD research data. Additionally, demonstrating the synergistic benefits of model fusion, the combined model performs better than the gradient boosting model alone. Our study confirms that the hybrid approach preserves the robustness of the individual models and improves accuracy is increased. As this model continues to be refined, it is poised to increase its application in ASD research, providing healthcare professionals and caregivers with a powerful tool to identify and support individuals across the autism spectrum. The consistent performance of the combined and individual models further highlights the consistency of the predictive power. This study shows the promise of machine learning integrated approaches in healthcare and offers a strong platform for future research in ASD prediction.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Patients in Predicting Renal Function Decline Integration of Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: The proposed study evaluates the critical role of machine learning (ML) algorithms in predicting renal function decline in individuals with chronic kidney disease (CKD). The crucial need originates from the limitations of traditional methods, which frequently depend on static models that are incapable of adjusting to the dynamic nature of CKD progression. These outdated ways of anticipating decline patterns lack precision, limiting early intervention and personalized patient care. The proposed system employs ML methods to improve prediction accuracy by combining patient-specific data, biomarkers, and clinical factors. The model outperforms other models in projecting renal function decline by using the capability of modern algorithms such as deep learning and ensemble approaches. The results of a comprehensive analysis show the proposed approach outperforms traditional methods, demonstrating its potential to transform CKD care. The study highlights the essential role of ML integration in boosting predictive capacities, allowing prompt treatments, and increasing outcomes for CKD patients.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Jewellery Design through Stable Diffusion Model: Bridging the Gap between Consumer Preferences and Designer Creativity
abstract: This study offers a novel approach that uses generative AI models such as stable diffusion models to produce a large number of jewellery designs, improve the design process, and increase consumer involvement. The jewellery business, which relies on designers’ expertise and creativity, is on the verge of a dramatic shift with the integration of AI-driven technologies. Our proposed approach serves as a creative middleman, combining consumer preferences and artistic ideas to provide a wide range of jewellery pictures. By allowing customers to choose from these AI-generated designs, the technology not only meets their expectations but also dramatically streamlines the designer’s productivity. This synergy between AI-generated solutions and human ingenuity not only reduces the time and effort required in the initial design phase, but also guarantees that the final product resonates more strongly with customer preferences. We go into the technical details of stable diffusion models, highlighting their ability to generate and customise high-quality images. Furthermore, we discuss how this technology affects efficiency, satisfaction, and creative expression. Our findings indicate that this method not only promotes a more collaborative and consumer-centric design process, but it also creates new opportunities for innovation in the jewellery sector. This study attempts to show how the combination of artificial intelligence and human creativity may reshape the paradigms of jewellery creation, making it more inclusive, efficient, and responsive to consumer demands.

articleTitle: A Robust Development of Calorie Prediction Methodology based on Artificial Intelligence Assisted Machine Learning Model
abstract: Modern people’s hectic schedules are a direct result of the ways they live and the responsibilities they have at work. On the other hand, maintaining a healthy lifestyle demands consistent physical exertion. Obesity is a result of people not paying attention to what they eat. As a result of modern living, obesity is on the rise. As a result, in order to maintain a healthy weight, people pick their food and exercise habits accordingly. People should know how many calories they consume and how many calories they burn. Calorie counts are easy to get online or on product labels, so it’s not hard to keep track of one’s calorie intake. There aren’t many tools available to help you keep track of the calories you burn. To keep up with the hectic pace of modern life and the constant search for shortcuts, we built a system that uses machine learning to track post-workout calorie burn and development. By taking a few attributes as input, this system can approximate the calories burned, which will show daily growth and motivate people to exercise more. This paper presents an innovative ML model for accurate calorie prediction; it’s called the Improved Learning Model for Calorie Prediction (ILMCP). To test how well it works, the authors cross-validate it with the traditional Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm. As a result, it is the quickest approach and may be utilized for object identification in real-time. Next, we’ll apply the ILMCP algorithm to the picture for segmentation. Foreground extraction with little to no user input requires it. Following picture segmentation, we use the probing object’s known volume to determine the food item’s volume. Once the volume has been determined, the food item’s mass may be determined using formulae. Then, the connection between weight and calories can be used to compute the food item’s calories.

articleTitle: Transforming Senior Care: Constructing a Mobile Chatbot-Based Personalized Healthcare System for Elderly Support
abstract: The review is about the introduction of in-home care in which the chatbots in mobile platforms and the rule-based systems are taking plays. This piece elaborates on the problems arising from the aging population around the planet and the importance of finding the fitting solutions on the level of prevention and treatment. In this study, technology, especially AI-powered chatbots, is pointed out as the crucial factor that spearheads the home-based geriatric care machinery. Subsequent, the ethical, legal, and privacy issues related with the implementation of such technologies in healthcare are considered. The review discusses the current technologies and the upcoming innovations tailored to specialised services for elders.

articleTitle: Exploring the Experimental Possibilities of an Intelligent Blood Pressure Prediction Scheme using IoT enabled Machine Learning Principles
abstract: Blood pressure is a severe worldwide public health issue that has an impact on every person. High blood pressure is a dangerous medical disease that can occasionally result in death and damage vital organs including the heart, brain, and kidneys.
